blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: AI-Scientists arrived, but a world for them to grow in did not. Human scientists take theirs for granted $-$ centuries of open problems and shared ideas, waiting in the scientific literature. To AI-Scientists, that world is readable but not runnable, so we build Scientist World for them: every research paper becomes an executable environment. Our autonomous pipeline extracts each paper's open-ended research question and reproduces its proposed method as the baseline; an AI-Scientist entering the environment is evaluated against what the human authors achieved. We release the first 1,000 verified environments. With the world as an evaluation, we found that frontier AI-Scientists can already surpass the human researchers 74% of the time. As a record of how AI does science, it contains 6,400 hours of research traces, with every idea, experiment, failure, and success. As a training ground, we are able to raise (+158%) a small model to match frontier models in research ideation. At last, AI-Scientists' own world has arrived, grown from and growing with science itself.
blocks.zh: AI-Scientists来了,但他们成长的世界却没有。 人类科学家理所当然地认为,他们在科学文献中等待着几个世纪的公开问题和共同的想法。 对AI-科学家来说,世界是可读的,但不可运行的,因此我们为他们建设科学家世界:每篇研究论文都成为可执行的环境. 我们的自主管道摘录每篇论文的不限名额的研究问题,并转载其拟议方法作为基线;一位进入环境的AI-科学家根据人类作者的成就进行评估. 我们释放了首批1000个经过验证的环境. 以世界为评价,我们发现前沿AI科学家已经超过了人类研究人员的74%的时间. 作为AI如何进行科学的纪录,它包含了6400小时的研究痕迹,每个想法,实验,失败,以及成功. 作为一个训练场,我们能够提升(+158%)一个小模型,以配合研究思想中的前沿模型. 终于,AI-Scientists自己的世界已经到来,从科学本身中成长和成长.

blocks.en: Figure 1 : We introduce Scientist World. Each research paper becomes an executable environment, where an AI-Scientist ’s Frontier-Normalized Improvement (FNI) is above zero when its method improves on the paper’s reproduced one. We test how well AI-Scientists improve existing research (left) and innovate new research from scratch (right). We show the best model of each lab plus the next best overall; full leaderboards are in Figure 12 .
blocks.zh: 图1 我们介绍科学家世界。 每份研究论文都成为一个可执行的环境,当AI-科学家的前沿规范改进(FNI)方法在所复制的论文上有所改进时,它就会超过零。 我们检验AI-Scientists如何改善现有的研究(左), 我们展示每个实验室的最佳模型 以及下一个最佳的整体。 完整的领导板在图12中。

blocks.en: § 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: § 翻译: 导言

blocks.en:
A new kind of scientist has arrived — for the first time, an intelligence advances the very thing it is made of. AI-Scientists are the first whose discoveries improve the discoverer ( Boiko et al., 2023 ; Gottweis et al., 2025 ; Mitchener et al., 2025 ) . They now invent new AI on their own ( Yamada et al., 2025 ; Schmidgall et al., 2025 ; Lu et al., 2026 ) .
This could set off a chain reaction, and every gain makes the next one faster ( Romera-Paredes et al., 2024 ; Novikov et al., 2025 ) .
This is the power of a scientist, the power of research.
blocks.zh:
一个新型的科学家来到了这里——第一次,一种智能推进了它所创造的东西。 AI-Scientists是第一个其发现改进了发现者(Boiko等人,2023年;Gottweis等人,2025年;Mitchener等人,2025年)。 它们现在独自发明新的AI(Yamada等人,2025年;Schmidgall等人,2025年;Lu等人,2026年)。
这可能会引发连锁反应,而每一增益都会使下一个反应更快(Romera-Paredes等人,2024年;Novikov等人,2025年)。
这是科学家的力量 研究的力量

blocks.en:
What is research? It is not a single ability, and it is not a single task.
Watch a scientist at work:
they read until they find something no one has explained, guess at the reason, and build an experiment to test it.
It fails.
They eventually figure out what the failure is telling them, adjust, and run it again.
It works.
Next month they are doing the same on a different problem, in a different part of the field.
What makes them a scientist is not any one of these moves;
it is the judgment that runs through all of them, and carries from one problem to the next.
That is why research cannot live in a single task.
Nailing one problem is a trick; research is the ability to discover again and again, problem after problem.
We believe the same for a scientist of AI.
blocks.zh:
研究内容是什么? 它不是一个单一的能力,也不是一个单一的任务。
看着科学家的工作:
他们读到的东西 没有人解释, 猜测原因, 并建立一个实验 测试它。
它失败了。
他们最终找出失败的真相,调整,再运行.
它的工作原理。
下个月,他们在另一个问题上也在做同样的事情。
是什么让他们成为科学家 不是其中之一;
判决贯穿了所有问题,从一个问题到另一个问题。
这就是为什么研究不能单靠一项任务。
钉住一个问题是一种诡计;研究是一次又一次地发现问题的能力,一个接一个的问题.
我们同样相信AI的科学家。

blocks.en:
A scientist like that keeps growing, and it needs a world big enough to grow in.
Human researchers already live in such a world: the scientific literature .
It provides two things.
The first is problem : each paper defines a different research question no single answer can exhaust.
The second is idea : each paper contributes to the field’s shared memory of approaches, findings, successes, and failures.
Together, they drive research as target and foundation. This is the world human scientists have always relied on, and the one AI-Scientists need.
blocks.zh:
这样的科学家会不断成长, 它需要一个能够成长的世界。
人类研究者已经生活在这样一个世界:科学文献。
它提供两件事。
第一个问题是问题:每篇论文都定义了一个不同的研究问题,没有一个单一的答案能够穷尽。
第二点是想法:每份文件都有助于实地对方法、发现、成功和失败的共同记忆。
它们共同推动研究成为目标和基础。 这是人类科学家一直依赖的世界,也是AI科学家需要的.

blocks.en:
We introduce Scientist World
: a living research universe built from the scientific literature itself.
In it, each paper becomes an executable scientific environment.
We designed a multi-agent pipeline for this conversion, with no human in the loop.
There are four steps: (1) reproduce the paper’s method until it recovers the paper’s result; (2) design a research task by defining what counts as scientific progress without shortcuts or gaming; (3) package it so it runs on any machine; and (4) verify it with independent agents.
An AI-Scientist is then scored by how much its own method improves over the human researchers’ method, which we call its Frontier-Normalized Improvement (FNI).
Building from high-quality papers, we first release 1,000 environments,
and it keeps growing with the literature (Figure 1 ).
blocks.zh:
我们介绍科学家世界
:一个由科学文献本身构建的活研究宇宙.
在其中,每篇论文成为可执行的科学环境.
我们为这种转换设计了一个多剂管道,没有人环。
有四个步骤:(1) 复制纸张的方法,直到它恢复纸张的结果;(2) 设计一项研究任务,确定什么是科学进步,没有捷径或游戏;(3) 将它装在任何机器上;以及(4) 与独立的代理人核实。
人工智能科学家的得分是,它自己的方法比人类研究者的方法改进了多少,我们称之为“前沿-标准化改进”。
以高质量的论文为基础 我们首先释放出1000个环境
并随着文献的不断增长(图1).

blocks.en:
Figure 2 : Where
Scientist World
stands. Prior AI-Scientist environments sit on the trade-off surface we describe; Scientist World reaches the corner where scale, evolve, and execution meet.
blocks.zh:
图2 :
世界科学家协会
站着 AI-Scientist之前的环境坐落在我们描述的权衡面上;Scientist World到达了规模,进化,执行交汇的角落.

blocks.en: Because the pipeline runs with no human in the loop, Scientist World is Scalable : it can grow fast to cover a broad range of fields and topics. Two more properties are inherited from science itself. Evolving : science never stands still, so a fixed set measures yesterday, what a scientist has already seen; Scientist World absorbs new literature every day, measuring research rather than recall. Execution-grounded : a fluent AI-Scientist can make any idea sound bold, but ideas that impress on paper might fail on execution ( Kapoor et al., 2024 ; Si et al., 2025 ) ; because every environment is built and measured through real experiments, research is judged by execution, not rhetoric.
blocks.zh: 由于管道循环无人运行,科学家世界是可扩展的:它可以快速增长,以涵盖广泛的领域和主题. 科学本身又继承了两个财产. 进化:科学从不停滞不前,所以昨天一个固定的尺度,一个科学家已经看到的东西;科学家世界每天吸收新的文献,测量研究而不是回忆。 (Kapor等人,2024年;Si等人,2025年);因为每一个环境都是通过真正的实验建立和测量的,研究是通过执行而不是修辞来判断的。

blocks.en:
Environments for research exist, but none, to our knowledge, holds the three properties together. Most are not scalable : they recycle problems from past competitions ( Huang et al., 2024 ; Chan et al., 2025 ; Nathani et al., 2025 ) , confine to simulated worlds ( Jansen et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2025b ) , or hand-pick tasks from a few papers ( Wijk et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025b ; Garikaparthi et al., 2026 ) . Nearly all are not evolving : sets are fixed at release and age into training data ( Sainz et al., 2023 ; Xu et al., 2024 ) , and those that refresh cover only narrower skills such as code ( Jain et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025a ) . And others are not execution-grounded : they reproduce results the field already knows ( Siegel et al., 2024 ; Starace et al., 2025 ; Kon et al., 2025 ) or judge proposed ideas as text ( Guo et al., 2025 ; Si et al., 2025 ) .
Scientist World holds three at once (Figure 2 ).
blocks.zh:
研究的环境是存在的,但据我们所知,没有一种环境将这三个特性结合在一起。 多数是无法扩展的:它们从以往的比赛中回收问题(Huang等人,2024年;Chan等人,2025年;Nathani等人,2025年),限于模拟世界(Jansen等人,2024年;Chen等人,2025年b),或从一些论文(Wijk等人,2025年;Zhang等人,2025年b;Garikaparthi等人,2026年b)中手取任务。 几乎所有的系统都没有演变:在发布时和年龄时固定在培训数据中(Sainz等人,2023年;Xu等人,2024年),以及仅更新到更窄技能的系统,如代码(Jain等人,2025年;Zhang等人,2025年a年)。 而另一些则不以处决为理由:它们复制了已经知道的结果(Siegel等人,2024年;Starace等人,2025年;Kon等人,2025年)或判断拟议想法为文本(Guo等人,2025年;Si等人,2025年)。
科学家世界同时举办三场(图2).

blocks.en:
We first use
Scientist World
to evaluate frontier AI-Scientists. Each scientist attempts an environment in two modes: improve , which starts from the paper’s idea with its reproduced method; and innovate , which starts from the problem alone. The two abilities prove distinct, since the best improver is not the best inventor.
Every attempt leaves a trajectory, each decision paired with the measured outcome of a real experiment, and we release this corpus alongside the environments. Then we train with it: rewarded only by real outcomes, a small scientist learns to propose ideas that, implemented by a fixed frontier executor, reach the frontier cohort’s level on the median held-out environment. Taken together, Scientist World is three things at once:
blocks.zh:
我们先用
世界科学家协会
评估前沿AI-科学家。 每个科学家都尝试用两种方式来创造环境:从论文的想法开始,用其复制的方法;从问题本身开始的创新。 这两个能力证明是不同的,因为最好的改进者不是最好的发明者。
每一次尝试都留下一个轨迹, 每一个决定都与一个真实实验的 测量结果结合, 我们释放这个体与环境。 然后我们用它来训练:一个小科学家学会提出一些想法,这些想法通过固定边界执行者的实施,在中位被搁置的环境中达到边界组群的水平。 总而言之,科学家世界是三件事:

blocks.en: • A benchmark. The standing measure of whether AI-Scientists can advance real research. • A dataset. A growing corpus of research being done, with every attempt preserved in full loop. • A gym. The same environments become training grounds, with real experimental results as rewards.
blocks.zh: • 基准。 AI-科学家能否推进真正研究的常态度量. • 数据集。 越来越多的研究正在进行中,每一次尝试都保持了完全循环。 • 健身房。 同样的环境成为训练基地,以真正的实验结果作为奖励.

blocks.en: A benchmark. The standing measure of whether AI-Scientists can advance real research.
blocks.zh: 基准。 AI-科学家能否推进真正研究的常态度量.

blocks.en: A dataset. A growing corpus of research being done, with every attempt preserved in full loop.
blocks.zh: 一个数据集。 越来越多的研究正在进行中,每一次尝试都保持了完全循环。

blocks.en: A gym. The same environments become training grounds, with real experimental results as rewards.
blocks.zh: 一个健身房。 同样的环境成为训练基地,以真正的实验结果作为奖励.

blocks.en: If research is the ability to discover again and again, it needs a world that never runs out. is that world, grown from science itself and open today. The chain reaction now has a place to happen.
blocks.zh: 如果研究是一次又一次发现的能力,它需要一个永不耗尽的世界. 那是一个从科学本身发展起来、今天又开放的世界。 连锁反应现在有发生的地方.

blocks.en: (a) we test how well they do research
blocks.zh: (a) 我们检验他们的研究情况

blocks.en: (b) we release their research traces
blocks.zh: (b) 我们释放他们的研究痕迹

blocks.en: (c) we raise a small scientist
blocks.zh: (c) 我们培养一个小科学家

blocks.en: Figure 3 : Scientist World is three things at once. One set of environments, grown from real papers, serves all three.
blocks.zh: 图3:科学家世界是同时三件事. 从真实的报纸上发展出来的一套环境服务于所有三种人。

blocks.en: § 2 From Papers to Environments
blocks.zh: § 翻译: 2 从论文到环境

blocks.en:
How well can AI-Scientists do research? Any answer must come from a research environment: a real problem to work on, and an objective measure of progress. A research paper is almost such an environment. It states a problem, proposes a method, and reports what happened. Yet it is only a record of science done, not a place to do science.
We turns the record back into the place. It (1) rebuilds the paper’s idea and experiment, (2) defines what constitutes an improvement, and (3) judges every scientist’s new solution.
blocks.zh:
AI-科学家能做多少研究?. 任何答案都必须来自研究环境:一个需要解决的真正问题,以及衡量进展的客观尺度。 研究论文几乎就是这种环境。 它提出一个问题,提出一种方法,并报告所发生的情况。 然而,它只是一份完成科学的记录,而不是一个完成科学的地方。
我们把记录 回到地方。 它 (1) 重建论文的想法和实验,(2) 定义什么是改进,(3) 评判每个科学家的新解决方案.

blocks.en:
We design builder agents to perform this conversion autonomously.
They reproduce a paper’s experiment, extract the problem to solve, and design both into a self-contained environment:
the problem becomes a task any new scientist can take up, and the reproduced result becomes the bar their solutions are scored against.
blocks.zh:
我们设计建造者代理 进行这种转换
他们复制了一篇论文的实验, 提取问题来解决, 并设计出一个自成一体的环境:
问题变成任何新科学家可以承担的任务, 复制的结果变成他们的解决方案被打中。

blocks.en: 2.1 The Builders
blocks.zh: 2.1 国家 构建者

blocks.en: We convert each paper through a sequence of agent iterations on one shared workspace (Figure 4 ). Four roles divide the work, from reproducing the paper to verifying the finished environment. A single paper can take hundreds of unattended turns without a human in the loop. To hold the sequence together, a ladder of milestones is used to track progress. Each rung marks how much of the environment stands, from a first runnable experiment to an environment ready for new scientists. A builder agent ends its iteration by reporting the rung it believes it reached; the next builder begins by checking and verifying that report. At the end of the builder iterations, the final environment is accepted or rejected based on the milestone reported.
blocks.zh: 我们通过一个共享工作空间上的代理迭代来转换每张纸(图4 )。 四个角色将工作区分开来,从复制论文到验证完成的环境. 单张纸可以走数百个无人看管的转弯,没有人环. 为了保持顺序一致,用一个里程碑梯子来跟踪进展。 每道跑道标志着环境的大小,从第一次可运行的实验到为新科学家准备的环境。 建设者代理人通过报告它相信达到的运行状态来结束其迭代;下一个建设者首先检查和核实报告. 在建设者迭代结束后,最终环境根据所报告的里程碑被接受或拒绝.

blocks.en: A paper moves through builder roles in iterations. Each agent inherits the workspace, audits the claimed milestone, and demotes whatever it cannot support. Every iteration ends at a gate: a milestone below the requirement reverts the work to an earlier iteration, or exits as failure. To be accepted, the experiment must run to support the paper’s central claim. We rotate different builder models across iterations to avoid any blind spots. What survives is a repository that any scientist can use without knowing how it was made.
blocks.zh: 一张纸通过迭代中的构建者角色移动. 每个代理人继承工作空间,审计声称的里程碑,并降级任何无法支持的东西。 每一次重复都以一个门结束:低于要求的里程碑使工作恢复到较早的重复,或者作为失败退出. 要被接受,试验必须进行,以证明文件的中央主张。 我们轮流使用不同的建构模型,以避免出现盲点。 幸存下来的是一个库 任何科学家都不用知道它是如何制造的

blocks.en: Figure 4 : Builders turn a paper into an environment. Construction runs like an assembly line: a published paper enters at one end, and a reusable research environment leaves the other. Specialized builders take turns on a single shared workspace, each refining what the previous one built and offloading heavy computation to a shared cluster. A quality gate guards the line, sending unfinished work back for another pass, so only what clears verification is accepted.
blocks.zh: 图4:建筑商将纸张变成环境。 建筑运行如组装线:一端是出版的论文进入,另一端是可重复使用的研究环境. 专业建筑师轮流使用一个共享的工作空间,每个工作空间都精炼了前一个建筑和卸载重计算到一个共享的集群. 质量门卫防守防线,将未完成的工作发回另一通通行证,所以只接受清除的核查.

blocks.en: The reproducer re-establishes the paper’s main result. It implements both the method and the paper’s original evaluation, from the authors’ code if released or from scratch otherwise. Its experiments scale up from quick checks toward the full run, until the result appears. What it leaves behind we call the source method and the source result : the reproduced method and the numbers it achieved.
blocks.zh: 复制人重新确定纸的主要结果. 它既执行方法,又执行论文的原始评价,从作者的代码看,如果发行或从头开始。 它的实验从快速检查扩大到全程,直到结果出现. 我们称之为源方法和源结果:复制的方法及其实现的数字。

blocks.en: The designer turns the reproduction into a task that others can attempt. It writes the problem statement that a new scientist will read, and it fixes the rules of the task: which metric to improve, which settings must stay fixed, and which kinds of solution are allowed. It sets the source result as the bar, so a new solution is scored by how much it improves on it. It prepares two evaluation sets: a visible one that the scientist may test against freely, and a held-out one to detect shortcuts or overfitting.
blocks.zh: 设计师将复制变成了别人可以尝试的任务. 它写了问题说明,一位新科学家会阅读,它修正了任务的规则:改进的衡量标准,必须固定哪些设置,允许何种解决方案. 它将源结果设定为巴,所以一个新的解决方案通过它能改善多少来得到分数. 它准备了两套评价:一套是科学家可以自由测试的可见评价,另一套是用来检测捷径或过于吻合的评价。

blocks.en: The packager makes the designed environment run anywhere, not only on machines that built it. It replaces every local file with a script that downloads it, and declares every dependency the experiments need. The check is simple: a fresh clone of the workspace must be able to rebuild and rerun on its own.
blocks.zh: 包装器使设计的环境在任何地方运行,而不只是在建造它的机器上运行. 它将每个本地文件替换为下载的脚本,并宣布每个实验所需的依赖性. 检查很简单:工作空间的新克隆必须能够自行重建和重新运行.

blocks.en: The verifier audits the packaged environment before it is accepted. It rereads the workspace with a skeptic’s eye, checking the code is valid, the scores match the logs, and the task follows the design rules. We keep this role separate on purpose, where the builder that grades the work never built it.
blocks.zh: 核查人先对包装环境进行审计,然后再予以接受。 它用怀疑者的眼睛重新阅读工作空间,检查代码是有效的,分数与日志相符,任务遵循设计规则. 我们故意把这个角色分开, 在那里,对工作进行分级的建筑师从来没有建造它。

blocks.en: Figure 5 : Using compute. A builder submits a job to the shared pool, sleeps, and is woken with the logs; its GPU budget is enforced outside the loop.
blocks.zh: 图5:采用计算法。 建设者向共享池提交工作,睡眠,并与日志一起被唤醒;其GPU预算在环外执行.

blocks.en: All experiments run on a shared pool of compute machines (Figure 5 ), described in § A with details. A builder never runs jobs on its own hardware: it submits a job, waits, and is woken with the logs when the job ends. We cap each paper’s GPU time a builder can use with a budget enforced outside the builder; when it runs out, the builder wraps up with what it has. With thousands of papers queuing, no single one deserves unbounded compute.
blocks.zh: 所有实验都运行在共享的计算机池上(图5),详见§A. 建设者从不在自己的硬件上运行工作:它提交工作,等待,并在工作结束后与日志一起被唤醒. 我们把每张纸的GPU时间限制在每张纸的GPU时间上,一个建纸者可以用一个在建纸者之外执行的预算;当它耗尽时,建纸者会用它所拥有的东西来结束。 千篇万篇的论文排队,没有一个人值得无约束的计算.

blocks.en: 2.2 The Environment
blocks.zh: 2.2 国家 环境

blocks.en: Figure 6 : Anatomy of an environment. A produced environment is a single self-contained workspace, laid out so the problem stays separate from the solution. The briefing , data , and scoring fix what to solve and how it is judged without referring to any one method, which keeps the task open to future approaches and stops a score from depending on the implementation. The method is the paper’s source method reproduced, and the scores it reaches are the reference we compare against, so a new method’s final score is the improvement it makes over them.
blocks.zh: 图6:环境解剖学。 产生的环境是单一的自成一体的工作空间,因此问题与解决方案分开。 简报、数据、评分, 这个方法就是所复制的纸的源法,它所获得的分数是我们所比较的参考,所以一种新的方法的最终分数是它比它们改进的.

blocks.en: An accepted environment is a paper refactored into an executable research setting. It does not ask a future scientist to reproduce the paper again; it gives that scientist a prepared place to work on the paper’s problem. The repository contains four parts, in the order a scientist encounters them: (1) a task briefing that states the problem, target, allowed direction, and constraints; (2) data and evaluation files that define what a method must produce and how it is scored; (3) the reproduced method and baselines, which provide starting solutions (the source method can optionally be withheld during evaluation); and (4) scripts, score files, logs, job outputs, and commits kept as the construction record. Figure 6 walks through one produced environment in full.
blocks.zh: 一个公认的环境是重新编成可执行的研究环境的论文. 它不要求未来的科学家再次复制论文;它为这位科学家提供了研究论文问题的准备场所。 该寄存器包含四个部分,按照科学家遇到它们的顺序:(1) 任务简报,说明问题,目标,允许的方向,和限制;(2) 数据和评价文件,确定一种方法必须产生什么,如何得分;(3) 复制的方法和基准,提供起始解决方案(在评价期间可以选择不使用源方法);(4) 脚本,分数文件,日志,工作输出,承诺作为构建记录保存. 图6显示了一个完整的生产环境。

blocks.en: An environment is more than reproduction code. It keeps the paper’s research situation open for new methods. We design each environment around three principles. First, builders may shrink the experiment scale to reduce compute cost, without changing the scientific question. The smaller task should still ask whether the paper’s idea improves the same kind of outcome under the same kind of evaluation. Second, the task must remain non-trivial. The source method should still leave a meaningful gap over simple baselines, so future methods have something real to improve. Third, we treat the reproduced method as one solution, not as the task itself. The data interface and evaluator are written independently of the source method, so a future method can replace it by producing the same kind of artifact.
blocks.zh: 一个环境不仅仅是复制代码. 它使论文的研究情况为新方法打开了大门。 我们围绕三项原则设计每个环境。 首先,建造者可能会缩小实验规模以减少计算成本,而不会改变科学问题. 较小的任务仍应问,该文件的想法是否在同类评价下改进了同类成果。 第二,任务必须保持非部落性质。 源法在简单的基线上仍应留有有意义的差距,因此,未来的方法确实有需要改进之处。 第三,我们将复制的方法视为一种解决办法,而不是任务本身。 数据接口和评价器是独立于源法而写成的,因此未来的方法可以通过生产同类文物来取代.

blocks.en:
We want a future method to win by making progress on the same question, not by changing the question itself.
So we write research rules across four files. The problem file states the research question. The target file names what should improve, such as loss or accuracy. The direction file says what kinds of method changes still answer that question. The constraints file lists changes we disallow because they would make the result about a different problem.
The constraints also rule out direct scale gains, for example by holding model size, data size, or compute budget fixed when those factors are not the research question.
blocks.zh:
我们希望通过在同一个问题上取得进展,而不是改变问题本身来赢得未来的方法。
因此,我们写研究规则 跨越四个文件。 问题文件陈述了研究问题. 目标文件名称应当改进,例如丢失或准确性。 方向文件说哪种方法的改变仍然能回答这个问题. 限制文件列出了我们不允许的更改,因为它们会给另一个问题带来结果.
制约因素还排除了直接规模收益,例如,在这些因素不是研究问题时,持有模型大小、数据大小或计算固定的预算。

blocks.en: A scientist’s proposed method is graded on how far it improves over the paper’s source method , on the quantity the claim is about, such as accuracy or loss. This can be viewed as a comparison with human researchers. We score the method over multiple experiments with different metrics used in the original paper. Besides a visible set for development, we reserve a held-out slice, so a method must improve the task rather than exploit one visible number through shortcuts or overfitting (§ E.3 ).
blocks.zh: 科学家建议的方法是根据它比纸张来源方法的改进程度、索赔涉及的数量(如准确性或损失)加以划分的。 这可以看作是与人类研究人员的比较. 我们用原始论文中所用的不同度量法,在多项实验中评分这一方法。 除了一个可见的开发集外,我们保留一个搁置的片段,因此一种方法必须改进任务,而不是通过快捷方式或过度调整来利用一个可见的数字(第E.3节)。

blocks.en: We introduce FNI, scored per paper as FNI = 100 ​ ∑ c w c ​ δ c / ( σ c ​ b ) \text{FNI }=100\sum_{c}w_{c}\,\delta_{c}/(\sigma_{c}b) , where δ c \delta_{c} is the signed gain over the source method on metric c c , w c w_{c} its weight, σ c \sigma_{c} a frozen frontier cohort’s spread on it, and b b sets the cohort’s mean | FNI | |\text{FNI }| to 100; 0 matches the paper, and negative is worse (§ E.3 ).
blocks.zh: 我们介绍FNI,每张纸的得分是FNI = 100 ∑ c w δ c / (σ c b )\ text { FNI QQ100\sum_c}w_{c}\,\delta_{c}/(\sigma_{c}b),其中 δc\delta_{c}是来源方法上的签名增益 rMc c,w cc}它的重量,\c\sigma_{c}一个被冻结的边疆组群的分布,b将组群的平均值 |FNI {{FNI}====100;0与论文匹配,负差(§E.3).

blocks.en: § 3 Scientist World
blocks.zh: §3 科学家世界

blocks.en: is the artifact built from the environment-construction system: the selected paper set, the generated repositories, and the records produced while building them. This section reports how we choose a valuable, buildable 1,000-paper source set and how the batch conversion ran.
blocks.zh: 由环境建筑系统建造的文物:选定的纸张集、生成的储存库和在建造过程中产生的记录。 本节报告我们如何选择一个有价值的,可建1000纸的源集,以及批量转换是如何运行的.

blocks.en: Figure 7 : Selecting 1,000 papers from 124,816 indexed. In a first pass (a), we drop papers that are low quality or are mainly a type of theory, a benchmark, a dataset, or a single finding, which leaves 21,354. In (b), we look at these more closely and favor work that is both high quality and compute-friendly , keeping the best 1,000. In (c), we check the result: the papers we picked (blue) are clearly stronger and more reproducible than the pool we started from (grey).
blocks.zh: 图7:从已索引的124 816份中选取1,000份论文。 在第一个通过(a)中,我们丢弃质量低或主要是一类理论,基准,数据集,或单一发现的论文,留下21,354. 在(b)中,我们更仔细地审视这些高质量和方便计算的工作,保持最好的1 000人。 在(c)中,我们检查结果:我们挑选的(蓝色)文件显然比我们从(灰色)开始的池子更强大,更可复制。

blocks.en: 3.1 Building at Scale
blocks.zh: 3.1 规模建筑

blocks.en:
Our selection pipeline keeps papers that are worth building under budget (Figure 7 ). We start from arXiv’s core AI categories over fourteen months to obtain 124,816 unique papers. We (1) run two fast screens with MiniMax M2.7 ( MiniMax, 2026 ) . The quality screen keeps papers in roughly the top 25% quality band. The type screen keeps empirical-method papers, whose main contribution is quantitative optimization. Together they leave 21,354 papers. Then (2) we run more detailed judgments for each paper on two quantities: research quality and reproduction difficulty (we prefer papers with low compute costs).
From the remaining pool, with a geometric-mean utility over quality and feasibility, we sample the category-balanced top 1,000 papers.
blocks.zh:
我们的挑选管道保存着值得建造的纸张,但列在预算之下(图7)。 我们从arXiv的AI核心类别开始, 我们(1)运行两台快速屏幕,使用MiniMax M2.7(MiniMax,2026). 质量屏幕将纸张保存在大约前25%的质量带. 类型屏幕保存经验式的论文,其主要贡献是量化优化. 他们一起留下了21,354份文件. 然后(2)我们对每篇论文进行更详尽的判断,分两种数量:研究质量和复制难度(我们更喜欢计算成本较低的论文).
从剩下的池子里,我们从质量和可行性上,抽取了分类平衡的上千份论文。

blocks.en: Table 1 : Per-paper and total build cost. Median and the total cost over 1,000 papers.
blocks.zh: 表1:纸面和总建筑费用。 中间和总成本超过1000篇论文.

blocks.en: No human reviews any paper at any stage in our pipeline. The source arXiv categories add roughly 9,000 unique papers per month, of which about 1,500 survive screening and remain feasible. The current 1,000 are the first release; future batches extend the window through the same pipeline.
blocks.zh: 在我们的管道中,没有任何人评论任何文件。 来源arXiv类别每月增加大约9 000份独特的论文,其中约1 500份在筛选后幸存下来,仍然可行。 目前1000系首次发布;未来批次通过同一管道延长窗口.

blocks.en: We build every paper with the same nine-iteration workflow: three reproducers, three designers, one packager, and two verifier passes (we repeat a role for multiple iterations for additional quality checks), with the model family rotating across GPT , Claude , MiniMax , and GLM . A paper may draw up to 70 GPU-hours, yet the median spends under half of one (Table 1 ).
blocks.zh: 我们用同样的九进制工作流程构建每张纸:3个复制人,3个设计人,1个包装人,以及2个验证人通行证(我们重复多个迭代的角色,以进行额外的质量检查),模型家族则在GPT,Claude,MiniMax和GLM之间旋转. 纸的长度可达70GPU小时,但中间值低于一半(表1)。

blocks.en: 3.2 The Built World
blocks.zh: 3.2 建成的世界

blocks.en: Figure 8 : The environment composition. The produced environments can be categorized into eight areas.
blocks.zh: 图8:环境构成。 所产生的环境可分为八个领域。

blocks.en: Table 2 : A produced environment on average. The mean size and makeup of one environment.
blocks.zh: 表2:平均生产环境。 一种环境的最小大小和化妆.

blocks.en: Table 3 : Quality and validity. How it reproduces paper method, beats baselines, and survives audit.
blocks.zh: 表3:质量和有效性。 如何复制纸质方法,比照基线,在审计中存活下来.

blocks.en: We first release 1,000 environments spread across eight areas (Figure 8 ). A scientist therefore meets problems of many kinds, not one narrow family. A typical environment is substantial, closer to a small research project than a single script (Table 2 ). Because most carry several experiments rather than a single headline result, a later method has multiple quantities to improve rather than one number to chase.
blocks.zh: 我们首先释放了分布在八个地区的1000个环境(图8). 因此,科学家遇到许多问题,而不是一个狭隘的家庭。 一个典型的环境是实质性的,比单一的脚本更接近一个小的研究项目(表2)。 因为大多数都携带数个实验而不是单一头条结果,所以后期方法有多个数量需要改进,而不是一个数字需要追逐.

blocks.en: Every environment is built without a human in the loop, so we do not take any single builder’s word for its quality. Four checks stand behind an accepted environment, one per row of Table 3 :
blocks.zh: 每一个环境都是没有人类环绕的,所以我们不以任何建筑者的话来解释其质量。 表3每行有一次检查,

blocks.en: • Reproduction fidelity. The reproduced source method’s numbers are checked against the paper’s reported results within a small margin, across every experiment and metric used by the environment; the few exceptions are accepted only with documented justification. • Baseline separation. Where a paper provides baselines, we reimplement them and require the reproduced source method to outperform them, preserving a real gap for future methods to close; the rate in Table 3 counts all 1,000 environments, including those without a reimplementable baseline. • Iterative cross-checking. Each builder audits the previous milestone claim and demotes whatever the workspace cannot support. A demotion rolls the workflow back to the previous iteration; construction then resumes from that checkpoint until it passes the later checks without further reversion. • Independent verification. The final environment must pass a verifier that did not participate in construction. Every released environment satisfies this final check.
blocks.zh: • 生育忠诚。 所复制的源方法的数字在小范围内,在环境使用的每一个试验和度量中与报出的结果对照;只有少数例外只有在有文件证明的情况下才被接受。 • 基线分离。 在文件提供基线时,我们重新实施这些基准,要求复制的源方法超过基准,为未来方法堵塞留下真正的空白;表3中的比率包括所有1 000个环境,包括没有可重新执行基线的环境。 • 迭代交叉核对。 每个建筑师对先前的里程碑索赔进行审计,并降级任何工作空间无法支持的东西。 降级将工作流程推回先前的重复;然后从该检查站恢复施工,直至通过以后的检查而不作进一步的恢复。 • 独立核查。 最后的环境必须经过没有参与建筑的核查者。 每一个释放的环境都满足了这个最终检查.

blocks.en: Reproduction fidelity. The reproduced source method’s numbers are checked against the paper’s reported results within a small margin, across every experiment and metric used by the environment; the few exceptions are accepted only with documented justification.
blocks.zh: 复制忠诚. 所复制的源方法的数字在小范围内,在环境使用的每一个试验和度量中与报出的结果对照;只有少数例外只有在有文件证明的情况下才被接受。

blocks.en: Baseline separation. Where a paper provides baselines, we reimplement them and require the reproduced source method to outperform them, preserving a real gap for future methods to close; the rate in Table 3 counts all 1,000 environments, including those without a reimplementable baseline.
blocks.zh: 基线分离。 在文件提供基线时,我们重新实施这些基准,要求复制的源方法超过基准,为未来方法堵塞留下真正的空白;表3中的比率包括所有1 000个环境,包括没有可重新执行基线的环境。

blocks.en: Iterative cross-checking. Each builder audits the previous milestone claim and demotes whatever the workspace cannot support. A demotion rolls the workflow back to the previous iteration; construction then resumes from that checkpoint until it passes the later checks without further reversion.
blocks.zh: 迭相诘问. 每个建筑师对先前的里程碑索赔进行审计,并降级任何工作空间无法支持的东西。 降级将工作流程推回先前的重复;然后从该检查站恢复施工,直至通过以后的检查而不作进一步的恢复。

blocks.en: Independent verification. The final environment must pass a verifier that did not participate in construction. Every released environment satisfies this final check.
blocks.zh: 独立核查。 最后的环境必须经过没有参与建筑的核查者。 每一个释放的环境都满足了这个最终检查.

blocks.en: Figure 9 shows one environment end to end. The paper’s question survives intact, whether a transformer can train without normalization, while its experiment shrinks to ImageNet-50 so attempts fit a bounded budget. The constraint is what keeps the task honest: the same model scale, data, and pretraining as the source method, so any gain must come from the method itself. Half of every evaluation stays hidden, so the score reflects what generalizes rather than what was tuned against the visible half.
blocks.zh: 图9显示一个环境终点。 报纸的问题还存在, 变压器能否在不正常化的情况下训练, 而它的实验却缩到ImageNet-50, 制约在于使任务保持诚实:与源方法相同的模型尺度,数据和预训,所以任何收益都必须来自方法本身. 每个评价的一半都隐藏着,因此得分反映了什么是概括性的,而不是与可见的一半相对应的。

blocks.en: Figure 9 : An example environment. This environment turns a Transformer architecture paper into a constrained improvement task: raise ImageNet accuracy without changing scale, pretraining, or data. The scripts make the task runnable, the source and baseline implementations anchor the comparison, and the scoring matrix defines progress as weighted improvement over the reproduced source method.
blocks.zh: 图9:实例环境。 这种环境将变形器架构纸变成了一个限制性的改进任务:提高ImageNet的准确性而不改变尺度,预训,或数据. 脚本使任务可以运行,源和基准执行锁定了比较,评分矩阵将进度定义为比复制源方法的加权改进.

blocks.en: Figure 10 : Environments’ openness. From fully prescribed (0) to fully open (100).
blocks.zh: 图10:环境的开放。 从完全规定的(0)到完全开放(100)。

blocks.en: Research rarely hands the scientist an approach. Deciding what to build is much of the work, and a world that always prescribes it would train executors rather than scientists. We therefore judge each task’s materials and place it on a 0 to 100 scale, where 0 means the approach is fully prescribed and 100 means the task fixes only what counts as success and leaves the way there entirely to the scientist. We find that every area covers nearly the whole range (Figure 10 ): the level of freedom of an environment depends on the task itself, not on where in the world it sits.
blocks.zh: 研究很少给科学家一个方法。 决定建造什么是大部分的工作,一个总是规定它会训练执行者而不是科学家的世界。 因此,我们判断每个任务的材料,并把它放在0到100的尺度上,其中0意味着完全规定了方法,100意味着任务只确定了什么才是成功的,而让科学家来决定。 我们发现每个领域几乎覆盖整个范围(图10):一个环境的自由程度取决于任务本身,而不是它所在的世界。

blocks.en: Each environment sets its own goal. Most tasks seek correctness (for example, pushing accuracy), and the rest split mostly between efficiency and robustness, with many naming more than one (Figure 11 ). No goal belongs to one area alone: correctness leads everywhere, efficiency appears from architecture to agents, and robustness reaches well beyond safety. The full chain from areas through goals to the work they take is shown in Figure 34 .
blocks.zh: 每一种环境都确定了自己的目标。 大多数任务都寻求正确性(例如,推力精确性),其余的任务大多分为效率与强性两个部分,许多任务命名不止一个(图11). 没有一个目标只属于一个领域:各地的正确性领导,效率从建筑到代理,强性远远超出安全范围。 图34显示从地区到目标到工作的全部环节。

blocks.en: Figure 11 : What the environments ask for. Each task names, in its own words, what should get better.
blocks.zh: 图11:环境要求什么。 每个任务的名称,用它自己的话来说,应该更好。

blocks.en: Figure 12 : Leaderboards. Mean FNI by model in improve mode (top) and innovate mode (bottom), averaged over visible and held-out splits. Zero matches the reproduced source method; higher is better. Improve mode gives models the source method, while innovate mode requires them to design from scratch. We use xhigh effort for all models.
blocks.zh: 图12:领导板。 在改进模式(顶级)和创新模式(下级)中,平均FNI的平均值大于可见和持有的分裂。 0与复制源方法匹配;更高更好. 改进模式赋予模型源方法,而创新模式则要求它们从零开始设计. 我们对所有的模型都付出了很大努力。

blocks.en: § 4 Scientists in the World
blocks.zh: §4 世界科学家

blocks.en: 4.1 Benchmark
blocks.zh: 4.1 基准

blocks.en: We now use the environments to evaluate AI-Scientists. Running every model on all 1,000 environments is too costly to repeat, so we evaluate on a fixed cohort of ten lower-compute environments. Each model attempts every environment under the same compute budget, in two modes:
blocks.zh: 我们现在利用环境来评价AI-科学家. 在所有1000个环境上运行每个模型成本太高,无法重复,所以我们评价了一组固定的10个低密环境. 每个模型都尝试在相同的计算预算下,采用两种模式:

blocks.en: • Improve mode. The model receives the reproduced source method and tries to improve its result. • Innovate mode. The model receives no source code and must design a method from scratch. We ensure there is no leakage of the paper’s original solution.
blocks.zh: • 改进模式。 该模型接收了复制的源方法,并试图改进其结果. • 创新模式。 该模型没有获得源代码,必须从头设计一种方法. 我们保证文件的原始解决方案不会被泄露。

blocks.en: Improve mode. The model receives the reproduced source method and tries to improve its result.
blocks.zh: 改进模式 。 该模型接收了复制的源方法,并试图改进其结果.

blocks.en: Innovate mode. The model receives no source code and must design a method from scratch. We ensure there is no leakage of the paper’s original solution.
blocks.zh: 创新模式. 该模型没有获得源代码,必须从头设计一种方法. 我们保证文件的原始解决方案不会被泄露。

blocks.en: Each attempt is evaluated on both the visible and held-out splits, with the final FNI score averaged across the two. Zero FNI matches the reproduced source method, while a positive FNI improves on it. Since different environments have different scoring scales, we normalize the scores to aggregate (§ E.3 ).
blocks.zh: 每一次尝试都按可见的和被搁置的分数来评价,最终FNI的分数平均为两分. 0FNI与复制的源法相匹配,而正的FNI则对其有所改进. 由于不同的环境有不同的评分表,我们把分数改为总分(E.3节)。

blocks.en:
In the result, the two modes show different strengths across models (Figure 12 ): Fable 5 is the strongest at improving existing methods, while Fable 5.1 and Fable 5 take the top two places at designing new methods from scratch. Among open models, GLM 5.2 comes closest to the frontier, placing third at innovating.
Notably, the AI-Scientists beat the paper’s reproduced method in 84% of improve and 74% of innovate attempts (§ F.1 ).
blocks.zh:
结果,两种模式在模型中表现出不同的长处(图12):Fable 5最能改进现有方法,而Fable 5.1和Fable 5则在设计新方法时从头到尾占据两个位置. 在开放型号中,GLM 5.2最接近边疆,位居创新第三.
特别是,AI-Scientists在84%的改进和74%的创新尝试中击败了论文复制的方法(第F.1节)。

blocks.en: Figure 13 : The two abilities are loosely tied. Each model’s rank at improving against its rank at innovating.
blocks.zh: 图13:两种能力松绑. 每个模型的排名在进步时与创新时的排名相比。

blocks.en: The leaderboards show which models score highest in FNI score, but not what kind of ability it reflects. We first compare the two modes directly. If improving an existing method and inventing a method from scratch measured the same skill, models would keep similar ranks across the two leaderboards. Instead, the relationship is loose (Figure 13 ). Some models are much stronger when building on source code, while others rank higher when forced to design from scratch. We therefore treat improve and innovate as related but distinct research abilities.
blocks.zh: 领跑板显示FNI分数中哪些型号得分最高,但没有显示它反映的是何种能力. 我们首先直接比较两种模式。 如果改进现有方法并从零开始发明方法,则模型将保持两个领导板的类似排名。 相反,这种关系是松散的(图13)。 一些模型在建立源代码时要强得多,而另一些模型则在被迫从零开始设计时排名更高. 因此,我们把改进和创新视为相关但独特的研究能力。

blocks.en:
Is performance just a scaling effect? Better results could come from scaling the attempt in two ways: using more external compute, or doing more model-side work through longer trajectories and more trial-and-error. We do not find either pattern. Compute hours and agent turns explain almost none of the variance in scores ( R 2 ≤ 0.02 R^{2}\leq 0.02 , Figure 14 a; turns are our provider-agnostic proxy for model-side effort, since token counts may not be
available). The leading models therefore do not win by simply spending more; they make better use of the same setting.
blocks.zh:
性能只是缩放效果? 更好的结果可以来自以两种方式扩大尝试:使用更多的外部计算,或者通过较长的轨迹和更多的试验和过错来做更多的模型侧工作. 我们没有发现这两种模式。 计算时数和经纪人转弯几乎不解释分数的差异(R 2 + 0.02 R + + + leq) 0.02,图14 a; 转弯是我们的供货商不可知的代名词 模型侧努力,因为符号计数可能不是
页:1 因此,主要模式不能仅仅通过花费更多的钱来赢得胜利;它们更好地利用同样的环境。

blocks.en: Then what drives it? The quality of the research itself. An LLM judge reads every attempt, blind to its score, and rates it on five properties: creativity (was the idea genuinely new, and did it pay off), engineering (was the implementation substantial, building on the existing code), rigor (was the reported gain real and honestly measured), significance (how far it moved the metric), and depth (how thoroughly the problem was explored). These ratings track the models’ actual scores almost exactly ( ρ = 0.89 \rho=0.89 , Figure 14 b): the models that win are the ones doing better research, not the ones trying hardest.
blocks.zh: 那么是什么驱使它? 研究本身的质量. 一位LLM法官阅读了每一个尝试,无视其得分,并以五个属性来评分:创造力(这个想法是真正新的,它是否有所回报),工程(执行是否是实质性的,在现有代码的基础上进行),严格(所报告的收益是否真实和诚实地衡量),意义(它如何移动了衡量标准)和深度(这个问题是如何彻底探讨的). 这些评分跟踪模型的实际分数几乎完全准确( ^ 0. = 0. 89\rho= 0. 89,图 14 b):获胜的模型是做更好研究的模型,而不是最努力的模型.

blocks.en: Figure 14 : Effort versus outcome, and research quality. (a) each run’s score against the compute hours (top) and agent turns (bottom) behind it, pooling both modes; effort explains almost none of the variance in score ( R 2 = 0.00 R^{2}=0.00 , 0.02 0.02 ). (b) research quality by dimension, judged apart from the score. Newest model per family, colored by provider.
blocks.zh: 图14:努力与结果,以及研究质量。 (a) 每一跑的得分与计算时数(上)和代理商(下)的得分相对应,将两种模式集中起来;努力几乎不解释得分的差异(R 2 = 0.00 R^{2 = 0.00 R^{2 = 0.02 = 0.02 ) 。 (b) 研究质量与得分不同。 每个家庭最新的模型,由供货商配色.

blocks.en:
Research is contingent. Research is inherently random. A strong attempt does not always produce a high score: a creative idea can be implemented well and still fail empirically, and a great idea might not suit the current setting, while a simpler idea may happen to work.
Aggregating across many environments
lets us measure progress without pretending that research has no outcome variance.
blocks.zh:
研究是有条件的。 研究本质上是随机的。 强烈的尝试并不总是能产生高分:一个创造性的想法可以很好地实施,在经验上仍然失败,一个伟大的想法可能不适应当前的环境,而一个简单的想法可能碰巧奏效.
跨越多种环境的聚合
让我们在衡量进展时不要假装研究没有结果差异。

blocks.en: 4.2 Dataset
blocks.zh: 4.2 数据集

blocks.en: Table 4 : Dataset statistics. Each experiment is stored with its log; hours of work is the scientist’s end-to-end running wall-clock time.
blocks.zh: 表4:数据集统计。 每一个实验都用它的日志存储;工时是科学家的端到端运行的墙钟时间.

blocks.en:
We preserve every scientist’s research in full, so
we collect a set of research traces,
released per environment, model, and run mode. We record the scientist’s research idea and their revisions, the method and the full turn-by-turn trajectory, and the per-experiment logs and scores (Table 4 ).
We store each attempt as a version-controlled repository,
so each preserves the complete development history rather than the final state alone.
blocks.zh:
我们保存每个科学家的全部研究,所以
我们收集了一组研究痕迹,
每个环境、模型和运行模式。 我们记录了科学家的研究想法及其修改、方法和整个转弯轨迹以及每个试验记录和分数(表4)。
我们把每次尝试都作为版本控制的存储库
因此,每一个都保留了完整的发展历史,而不是仅仅保留最终状态.

blocks.en:
In total, the corpus records roughly 6,400 hours of research being done (§ H.1 ).
With multiple scientists’ attempts, one environment accumulates multiple independent solutions to a fixed problem, each labeled with its measured improvement over the reproduced source result.
blocks.zh:
总共记录了大约6 400小时的研究(第H.1节)。
在一个科学家的多次尝试下,一个环境对一个固定问题积累了多种独立的解决方案,每个都标注在它相对于复制源结果的有分量的改进上.

blocks.en: Finally, we raise a scientist of our own. We train Qwen3-8B ( Qwen Team, 2025 ) , a scientist small enough that whatever it learns must come from the world, with Tinker ( Thinking Machines Lab, 2025 ) , in two stages:
blocks.zh: 最后,我们培养出一位自己的科学家。 我们训练Qune3-8B(Quen Team, 2025年), 一个足够小的科学家, 无论它学到什么,都必须来自世界,

blocks.en: Figure 15 : Raised in the world. Median held-out FNI of each stage’s ideas, implemented identically; after GRPO it reaches the frontier cohort’s anchor.
blocks.zh: 图15:世界的成长。 每个阶段的构想均以相同方式实施;在GRPO之后,它就到达了边境组的锚地。

• Supervised fine-tuning. 1,000 examples drawn from the trajectories, each pairing a task specification with an attempt’s reasoning and final idea, cleaned so that no fabricated result survives. (details in § H ) • GRPO. We do off-policy group relative policy optimization (GRPO) ( Shao et al., 2024 ) on 1,500 already-scored ideas, rewarded by measured outcomes.
Advantages are relative to the other ideas for the same task, and updates are clipped to a trust region around the SFT policy.
The scientist trains only with execution.

• 监督微调。 从轨迹中抽取了1000个例子,每个例子都把任务规格与尝试的推理和最终想法配对起来,清理干净,这样就不会有捏造的结果。 (详见H节) • GRPO. We do off political group 相对政策优化(GRPO)(Shao et al., 2024)在1500个已经得分的想法上,通过衡量结果来奖励.

blocks.en: Supervised fine-tuning. 1,000 examples drawn from the trajectories, each pairing a task specification with an attempt’s reasoning and final idea, cleaned so that no fabricated result survives. (details in § H )
blocks.zh: 监督细调. 从轨迹中抽取了1000个例子,每个例子都把任务规格与尝试的推理和最终想法配对起来,清理干净,这样就不会有捏造的结果。 (详见H节)

blocks.en:
GRPO. We do off-policy group relative policy optimization (GRPO) ( Shao et al., 2024 ) on 1,500 already-scored ideas, rewarded by measured outcomes.
Advantages are relative to the other ideas for the same task, and updates are clipped to a trust region around the SFT policy.
The scientist trains only with execution.
blocks.zh:
(原始内容存档于2018-09-13). GRPO. 我们针对1500个已有分数的想法,对政策外的集团进行相对政策优化(GRPO)(Shao等人,2024年),通过衡量结果给予奖励。
相对于同一任务的其他想法而言,优势在于,更新被剪辑到围绕SFT政策的信任区域.
科学家只能执行

blocks.en: A scientist this small cannot yet carry the whole loop: implementing and debugging a method over a long horizon is frontier work in itself. We therefore separate ideation from implementation ( Si et al., 2026 ) . The trained scientist proposes the idea, and a single fixed frontier implementer ( GPT 5.6 Sol ) executes every idea under identical conditions on ten held-out papers (§ H.4 ), so only the idea’s origin varies. We prompt the implementer to follow exactly the ideator’s idea.
blocks.zh: 一个如此小的科学家还不能携带整个循环:在漫长的视野里执行和调试一种方法本身就是前沿工作。 因此,我们将想法与执行分开(Si等人,2026年)。 训练有素的科学家提出了这个想法,只有一个固定的前沿执行者(GPT 5.6 Sol)在10份搁置的论文(§ H.4)中执行每个想法,因此只有这个想法的起源不同。 我们促使执行者完全遵循构思者的想法。

blocks.en:
The gain is monotone. The median implemented idea scores 41 FNI from the base scientist, 84 after SFT, and 106 after GRPO (Figure 15 ); the mean rises from 51 to 90.
Ideas from the trained scientist, faithfully implemented, reach the anchor of the frontier cohort. What it demonstrates is the mechanism: the world supplied the data, the reward, and the held-out exam, and a scientist raised on its trajectories proposes measurably better research. The training loop works end to end.
blocks.zh:
增益为单通. 中位执行思想从基础科学家中得分41 FNI,在SFT之后得分84分,在GRPO之后得分106分(图15);平均从51升至90分.
训练有素的科学家的想法, 忠实地执行, 到达前沿组的锚。 它所显示的就是这个机制:世界提供了数据、奖励和延期考试,一位在轨迹上被培养出来的科学家提出了可以衡量更好的研究。 训练循环工程结束.

blocks.en: § 5 Background
blocks.zh: § 翻译: 5 背景情况

blocks.en: Automating discovery is a long-standing goal. Early systems recovered natural laws and governing equations directly from data ( Schmidt and Lipson, 2009 ; Cranmer et al., 2020 ; Udrescu and Tegmark, 2020 ) , and robot scientists closed the loop from hypothesis to physical experiment ( King et al., 2004 ; King et al., 2009 ; Williams et al., 2015 ) . Within machine learning, automated search took over bounded parts of the pipeline: model and hyperparameter selection ( Thornton et al., 2013 ; Feurer et al., 2015 ) , neural architecture design ( Zoph and Le, 2017 ; Real et al., 2019 ) , and even the discovery of faster fundamental algorithms ( Fawzi et al., 2022 ; Mankowitz et al., 2023 ) . Program search guided by language models extended this to open mathematical and algorithmic problems ( Romera-Paredes et al., 2024 ; Novikov et al., 2025 ) . Language models then widened the scope toward the full workflow: tool-augmented systems run their own chemical experiments ( Boiko et al., 2023 ; Bran et al., 2024 ) , and agentic pipelines generate ideas, write code, and draft papers end to end ( Lu et al., 2024 ; Yamada et al., 2025 ) . A newer wave organizes many agents into collaborative or self-directed discovery loops ( Schmidgall et al., 2025 ; Schmidgall and Moor, 2025 ; Ghareeb et al., 2026 ) , and general-purpose AI-Scientists now attempt discovery across whole fields ( Gottweis et al., 2025 ; Mitchener et al., 2025 ) . This line builds better scientists; is complementary, turning finished papers into environments where such scientists can be handed the same problem and scored on it.
blocks.zh: 自动化发现是一个长期的目标. 早期系统直接从数据中恢复自然定律和方程(Smidt and Lipson,2009年;Cranmer等人,2020年;Udrescu and Tegmark,2020年),机器人科学家关闭了从假说到物理实验的循环(King等人,2004年;King等人,2009年;Williams等人,2015年)。 在机器学习中,自动化搜索接管了管道的界限部分:模型和超参数选择(Thornton等人,2013年;Feurer等人,2015年),神经架构设计(Zoph和Le,2017年;Real等人,2019年),甚至发现更快的基本算法(Fawzi等人,2022年;Mankowitz等人,2023年). 由语言模型指导的程序搜索将它扩展至打开数学和算法问题(Romera-Paredes等人,2024年;Novikov等人,2025年)。 语言模型随后将范围扩大到整个工作流程:工具强化系统自行进行化学实验(Boiko等人,2023年;Bran等人,2024年),以及代理管道产生想法、写代码和论文草稿结束(Lu等人,2024年;Yamada等人,2025年)。 新浪将许多物剂组织成协作或自导的发现环(Schmidgall等人,2025年;Schmidgall和Moor,2025年;Ghareeb等人,2026年),以及通用AI-科学家现在试图在整个领域进行发现(Gottweis等人,2025年;Mitchener等人,2025年)。 这条线建设了更好的科学家;是相辅相成的,将成品论文转化为环境,使这些科学家能够把同样的问题交给他们,并在上面打分.

blocks.en: Evaluating agents in executable settings began with general benchmarks for tool use and repository-level code editing ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2024 ; Mialon et al., 2024 ) , then moved to machine-learning experimentation and engineering ( Huang et al., 2024 ; Chan et al., 2025 ; Wijk et al., 2025 ; Nathani et al., 2025 ) . A parallel line probes scientific reasoning and data-driven discovery ( Jansen et al., 2024 ; Majumder et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2025b ) , extending to hypothesis formation and frontier domain research ( Liu et al., 2025 ; Miao et al., 2026 ) . A closely related group scores whether an agent can reproduce a paper’s results from its description ( Siegel et al., 2024 ; Starace et al., 2025 ) , reimplement its method and code ( Xiang et al., 2025 ; Hua et al., 2025 ) , or take on research framed as an open-ended challenge ( Zhang et al., 2025b ; Chen et al., 2025a ) . These suites are almost always fixed and hand-curated, and critiques of agent evaluation warn that they can confound cost, leak through weak holdouts, and reward shortcuts ( Kapoor et al., 2024 ) . Concurrent work also turns real papers into research tasks but curates them by hand, which does not scale ( Garikaparthi et al., 2026 ) . instead treats construction itself as the object: it selects papers at scale and refactors each into a scored, reproduce-then-improve environment, so a method is judged by its gain over a faithfully reproduced result rather than its distance from a reported number.
blocks.zh: 在可执行环境中评价剂开始采用工具使用和存储器一级编码编辑的一般基准(Jimenez等人,2024年;Liu等人,2024年;Mialon等人,2024年),然后转入机器学习实验和工程(Huang等人,2024年;Chan等人,2025年;Wijk等人,2025年;Nathani等人,2025年)。 平行线探测科学推理和数据驱动的发现(Jansen等人,2024年;Majumder等人,2024年;Chen等人,2025年b),延伸至假设形成和前沿域研究(Liu等人,2025年;Miao等人,2026年). 一个关系密切的组分是,一个代理人是否能够从其描述中复制论文的结果(Siegel等人,2024年;Starace等人,2025年),重新实施其方法和代码(Xiang等人,2025年;Hua等人,2025年),还是将研究视为一个无限制的挑战(Zhang等人,2025年b;Chen等人,2025年a). 这些套房几乎总是固定和手工加工的,对代理评价的批评警告说,它们可能混淆成本,通过薄弱的阻力泄漏,以及奖励捷径(Kapor等人,2024年)。 同时期的工作也把真实的论文变成研究任务,但用手来解析,这并没有规模化(Garikaparthi等人,2026年),而是把构造本身当作对象:它按规模选择论文,将每篇重塑成一个得分的,复制的,当时改进的环境,所以一种方法通过忠实复制的结果来判断其收益,而不是从它与报告数字的距离来判断.

blocks.en: § 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: §6 结论

blocks.en: Every published paper with code is a finished piece of research: a problem, a method, and a measured result. turns that record back into a place where research happens: 1,000 papers become runnable, scored environments, and the collection grows with the literature rather than with annotation effort. The same environments measure today’s AI-Scientists and train the next ones; each is a scaled-down paper and each score one contingent trajectory, but the loop they are built for, a scientist that proposes, executes, and updates inside the world, is just beginning. As the models and the literature both move, the world keeps pace, and the problems it poses stay as open as the research it was built from.
blocks.zh: 每一份有代码的出版论文都是完成的研究作品:一个问题,一个方法,以及一个测量的结果. 将记录重新变成研究发生的地方: 1000篇论文变得可以流传,得分环境,藏品随着文献而不是注释努力而增长. 同样的环境衡量今天的AI-Scientists并训练下一位科学家;每张都是一张缩放的纸,每张都得分一个或有轨迹,但他们所建的环路,一位在世界范围内提出、执行和更新的科学家,刚刚开始。 随着模型和文献的移动,世界也跟上了步伐,它带来的问题和它从研究中产生的一样开放。

blocks.en: Appendix A System Design
blocks.zh: 附录A 系统设计

blocks.en: relies on agents that repeatedly alternate between reasoning and computation. This agent stack is the substrate that makes this loop practical at scale. It separates four concerns that are otherwise entangled: running compute jobs, bounding each experiment’s resource use, coordinating many papers, and normalizing different agent interfaces. We separate the system into four parts: Hive provides the compute pool; Nexus makes compute accountable to a particular attempt; Swarm coordinates many runs; and Worker presents each agent scaffold through the same interaction contract. Figure 16 summarizes these layers.
blocks.zh: 依赖于在推理和计算之间反复交替的代理. 这个代理堆栈是使这个循环在规模上实用的底物. 它将原本缠绕的4个问题分开:运行计算任务,约束每个实验的资源使用,协调许多文件,以及使不同的代理界面正常化. 我们把系统分为四个部分: 蜂巢提供计算池;Nexus使计算对特定尝试负责;Swarm协调许多运行;Worker通过相同的交互合同向每个代理脚手架介绍. 图16概述了这些层次。

blocks.en: Figure 16 : System design overview. Hive supplies execution capacity for CPU and GPU jobs; Nexus accounts for the budget and resource boundary of each attempt; Swarm maintains one paper-level trajectory across roles, restarts, and handoffs; and Workers connect different agent scaffolds through the same system interface. Together, these layers let many agents iterate on open-ended papers while preserving the evidence, budget state, and handoff context.
blocks.zh: 图16:系统设计概览。 蜂窝为CPU和GPU的工作提供执行能力; Nexus为每次尝试的预算和资源边界进行核算; Swarm维持一个纸张级的轨迹,跨越角色,重启,和交接; Workers通过同一系统接口连接不同的代理脚手架. 这些层层一起使许多代理人在保留证据、预算状况和交割上下文的同时,在不限名额的文件中强调。

blocks.en: A.1 Hive: Interactive Compute Pool
blocks.zh: A.1 蜂巢:交互式计算池

blocks.en: Agent-driven reproduction needs a compute layer designed for interactive iteration. An agent may run a small debugging command, inspect the result, edit the code, and then launch a longer training or evaluation job. If every such step pays the full overhead of acquiring resources and preparing execution, the research loop becomes dominated by infrastructure latency rather than by scientific reasoning. Hive keeps compute capacity available, monitored, and controlled, so these iterations remain close to an interactive workflow.
blocks.zh: 代理驱动的复制需要为交互迭代设计的计算层. 代理人可以运行一个小调试命令,检查结果,编辑代码,然后启动更长的训练或评价工作. 如果每个这样的步骤都支付获得资源和准备执行的全部间接费用,则研究循环就会以基础设施长期性而不是以科学推理为主。 蜂窝不断计算可用能力,监测和控制,因此这些迭代仍然接近于交互工作流程.

blocks.en: Hive exposes compute as an experimental action: given a requested experiment, declared resources, and a workspace, it reports what happened. The result is not only a terminal success or failure label. It includes the execution evidence the agent needs to decide what to do next: logs, completion status, timing, and partial output when a job is still running. This matters because reproduction agents rarely need a single monolithic training run; they work through a trial and error sequence of tests, attempts, fixes, ablations, and evaluations. Figure 17 shows the execution path inside Hive.
blocks.zh: 蜂窝暴露出计算是一种实验性动作:给一个请求的实验,申报的资源,和一个工作空间,它报告发生的事情. 结果不仅仅是终端成功或失败标签. 它包括代理商需要决定下一步要做什么的执行证据:日志,完成状态,时间,以及当某项工作仍在运行时的部分输出. 这一点很重要,因为复制代理很少需要一次单一的训练;他们通过测试、尝试、修正、模拟和评价的试验和错误序列来工作。 图17显示了Hive内部的处决路径.

blocks.en: Figure 17 : Hive execution overview. A job request enters Hive with a command, resource target, working directory, and time limit. Admission queues the request, dispatch routes it to test, CPU, or GPU capacity, and monitor records the return code, runtime, and logs that form the job record.
blocks.zh: 图17:蜂窝处决概况。 工作请求输入 有命令、资源目标、工作目录和时限的蜂巢。 录用排队请求,发送用于测试,CPU,或GPU容量的路由,并监控返回代码,运行时间,以及构成工作记录的日志.

blocks.en: Hive’s input is a job request. In our interface, the concrete entry point is a terminal command: hive submit , whose parameters specify what should run. --workdir anchors the run to the code and files it should see, --gpus and --cpus declare the requested capacity, --resource targets a named pool such as test, CPU, or GPU capacity, and --timeout-sec bounds jobs that hang or run past their intended scale. Optional fields such as retry count and log directory make the request easier to recover and inspect. These fields are useful because they turn an open shell command into a schedulable execution unit: Hive can decide where it can run, how much capacity it needs, when it should stop, and where its evidence should be recorded.
blocks.zh: 蜂巢的投入是工作要求。 在我们的界面中,混凝土入口是一个终端命令:蜂巢提交.,其参数指定应该运行什么. --workdir 锁定到它应该看到的代码和文件, -- gpus 和 -- cpus 声明请求的容量, -- 资源瞄准一个命名的集合, 如测试、 CPU 或 GPU 容量, 以及 -- Timeout-sec 绑定挂起或运行过预定规模的工作 。 复试计数和日志目录等可选字段使请求更容易恢复和检查. 这些字段是有用的,因为它们将一个打开的 shell 命令变成一个可按期执行的单元: 蜂巢可以决定它能跑到哪里,需要多少能力,何时应该停止,在哪里应该记录它的证据.

blocks.en: Hive returns a job identifier and maintains a job record, not an experiment-specific result file. The record directory contains meta.json , stdout.log , and stderr.log : metadata for status, timing, resource use, and return code, plus streamed logs for diagnosis. Any checkpoints, metrics, or plots created by the command remain in the working directory; Hive records how the execution went.
blocks.zh: 蜂巢返回工作标识符,并保持工作记录,而不是特定实验结果文件. 记录目录包含 meta.json , stdout.log 和 stderr.log:用于状态,时间,资源使用和返回代码的元数据,加上用于诊断的流日志. 由指挥部建立的任何检查站、衡量标准或地块都保留在工作目录中; 蜂窝记录执行过程。

blocks.en: A job asks for a category of resource (test, CPU, or GPU) and Hive places it on whatever node is free, without the agent naming a specific machine. The pool can grow or shrink as capacity becomes available, so the first worker to come online is useful immediately, and the same request format serves every experiment.
blocks.zh: 任务需要一类资源(测试,CPU,或GPU),而Hive将它放在任意的节点上,而不需要代理指定特定的机器命名. 游泳池可以随着容量的增加或收缩,所以第一个上网的工人马上有用,同样的请求格式为每一个实验服务.

blocks.en: Hive exposes three node types through the same job interface. CPU nodes support CPU-only experiments, setup, preprocessing, and other jobs that do not require accelerators. GPU nodes run accelerator-heavy experiments such as training and large-scale evaluation. Test nodes are for quick code validation and small-scale testing, with jobs capped at one hour so agents do not tie up long-running allocations.
blocks.zh: 蜂窝通过同一工作界面曝光三种节点类型. CPU节点支持只使用CPU的实验,设置,预处理,以及其他不需要加速器的工作. GPU节点运行加速器-重力实验,如培训和大规模评价. 测试节点用于快速代码验证和小规模测试,工作上限为1小时,因此代理商不会绑定长期分配.

blocks.en: Long-running jobs are not perfectly reliable: a job can stall or be killed before it finishes, and its partial output is often still useful. Hive therefore treats an interruption as a reportable outcome rather than a silent failure: it writes the job’s last state and logs into the job record, then requeues it on another valid machine, where the command restarts from the beginning; the interrupted attempt is recorded for inspection like any completed one, and its incomplete work is not charged against the budget.
blocks.zh: 长期运行的工作并不完全可靠:一个工作在完成之前可以拖延或被杀死,其部分产出往往仍然有用. 因此,蜂巢将中断视为一个可报告的结果,而不是沉默的失败:它将工作的最后状态写入工作记录,然后重新排在另一个有效的机器上,命令从一开始就重新开始;中断的尝试像任何完成的尝试一样被记录检查,其不完整的工作不由预算支付.

blocks.en: We use Ray ( Moritz et al., 2018 ) to implement Hive. Ray starts each job on a free machine and runs it; everything else the compute pool needs for agent-driven reproduction is built on top. A resource manager tracks CPU, GPU, and test capacity; a dispatcher turns agent requests into queued jobs; an agent-facing client/API submits jobs and streams progress back; and a persistent job store records logs, status, and final outputs outside the Ray runtime. These pieces are what make the compute pool usable as research infrastructure, not just a distributed execution engine.
blocks.zh: 我们使用Ray(Moritz等人,2018年)来执行Hive. 雷用免费的机器开始每一项工作并运行它;其他所有对代理驱动复制的计算池需求都建在顶部. 一个资源管理器跟踪CPU,GPU,以及测试能力;一个调度器将代理请求转换为排队任务;一个代理客户端/API提交任务和流向回递进展;以及一个持续的工作存储记录日志,状态,以及Ray运行时间以外的最终输出. 这些作品使得计算池可以用作研究基础设施,而不仅仅是一个分布式执行引擎.

blocks.en: A.2 Nexus: Experiment Boundary
blocks.zh: A.2 Nexus:实验边界

blocks.en: Nexus is the experiment boundary that manages the resources agents use. It is a bridge between agents and compute. An autonomous agent should not be trusted to enforce its own compute budget simply because the prompt tells it to be careful. Nexus makes the budget a property of the system. Each reproduction attempt receives a bounded project: jobs must fit within its resource limits, its concurrent usage cap, and its remaining GPU-hour budget before they are allowed to run. Compute is no longer something the agent can spend freely; every job is counted against the project’s budget. The operations view in Figure 18 shows these exchanges: agents submit or review jobs through Nexus, and Nexus communicates between infrastructures and agents.
blocks.zh: Nexus是管理资源剂使用的实验边界. 这是代理和计算之间的桥梁。 不应仅仅因为提示器要求自己小心,就相信一个自主的代理人会执行自己的计算预算. Nexus将预算作为系统的财产. 每次复制尝试都得到一个有限度的项目:工作必须符合其资源限度、同时使用上限以及剩余GPU小时预算,然后才允许运行。 计算不再是代理商可以自由花费的东西;每份工作都计入项目预算。 图18中的操作视图显示这些交换:代理人通过Nexus提交或审查工作,Nexus在基础设施和代理人之间进行交流。

blocks.en: Figure 18 : Nexus operations overview. Nexus stores the job, project, budget, and review state needed to translate agent requests into Hive actions and to translate Hive execution evidence back into agent decisions.
blocks.zh: 图18: Nexus业务概况. Nexus存储工作、项目、预算和审查状态需要将代理请求转换为蜂巢行动并翻译 把行刑证据放回代理人的决定中

blocks.en: Nexus enforces several constraints that matter for reproducibility: how much compute a paper can spend in total, how much it can hold at once, which kinds of resources it may use, and how long any single job may run before it times out. At the job level, these limits cover CPU, GPU, memory, and time requests. These constraints are checked outside the agent. The project-level example in Figure 19 makes the gate concrete: a request can be rejected because it exceeds the remaining budget or concurrency capacity, or requests a resource pool outside the given policy.
blocks.zh: Nexus执行了若干对可复制性很重要的限制:一纸可以总共花费多少计算,它可以同时持有多少,它可以使用何种资源,以及任何单一的工作在它用完之前可能运行多久. 在工作层面,这些限制涵盖了CPU,GPU,内存,以及时间请求. 这些限制在特工之外检查。 图19中的项目级实例使闸门混凝土化:一个请求可以被拒绝,因为它超过了剩余的预算或货币容量,或者请求在特定政策之外的资源池.

blocks.en: Figure 19 : A Nexus project turns resource policy into explicit accept/reject decisions. The example shows how budget, concurrency, and allowed resource pools gate agent requests before they reach Hive.
blocks.zh: 图19:Nexus项目将资源政策转化为明确接受/拒绝的决定。 例子说明预算、货币和允许资源池门代理在到达蜂巢之前如何提出要求。

blocks.en: This accounting matters for both fairness and interpretability. Without it, one agent can consume resources in ways that alter the conditions for others, and the resulting comparison would conflate scientific difficulty with uncontrolled resource use. With Nexus, the amount of compute available for a single reproduction is explicit and enforceable. The agent can still decide how to reasonably spend its budget, but it cannot silently exceed the given total.
blocks.zh: 这种核算对于公平和可解释性都很重要。 如果没有这种资源,一种物剂就能够以改变其他物剂条件的方式消耗资源,由此进行的比较将把科学上的难题与不受控制的资源使用混为一谈。 与Nexus一起,单次复制可用的计算量是明确且可执行的. 代理人仍然可以决定如何合理使用其预算,但不能默默地超过规定的总额.

blocks.en: Nexus makes long jobs interruptible without requiring the agent to keep an active turn open for the whole execution. At each configured review interval, Nexus snapshots the latest logs, records them in the workspace, and wakes the responsible agent to inspect them. The agent can then continue the run, cancel it, or change strategy before spending the remaining budget. Interval review pays off because many broken reproductions are visible well before natural termination: imports fail after setup, data paths are wrong, losses diverge, or an evaluator writes clearly invalid output. A run that would otherwise consume hours can stop after the first snapshot that shows it is going nowhere. If the agent does not respond within the review window, Nexus continues the job rather than leaving compute blocked by a missing response.
blocks.zh: Nexus使得长时间的工作可以中断,而不要求代理机构为整个执行保持主动转弯. 在每一个配置的审查间隔时,Nexus都会快照最新的日志,在工作空间中记录,并叫醒负责的代理来检查. 然后,代理可以继续运行,取消运行,或者在花费剩余预算之前改变策略. 间歇性审查之所以有回报,是因为许多破损的复制在自然终止之前早已可见:在设置后进口失败,数据路径错误,损失差异,或者评价者写出明显无效的输出. 要不然会耗时数小时的运行,在第一个快照显示它无处可去之后,就可以停止. 如果代理商没有在审查窗口内回复,Nexus继续工作,而不是因回复缺失而留下计算障碍.

blocks.en: This layer is intentionally separate from Hive, and can accept any compute infrastructure. Nexus is optimized for accountability. Keeping them separate prevents the compute pool from accumulating task-specific policy and prevents Swarm from having to reason about low-level execution state.
blocks.zh: 这个层是故意与蜂巢分离的,可以接受任何计算基础设施. Nexus优化问责. 将它们分开可以防止计算池累积特定任务的政策,防止Swarm对低级执行状态有一定理由.

blocks.en: A.3 Swarm: Builder Coordination
blocks.zh: A.3 沼泽:建筑商协调

blocks.en: Swarm has two jobs. The first is per paper: it drives one reproduction across many agent turns and several roles, keeping the attempt coherent as builders hand off, retry, and audit each other’s work. The second is across papers: it runs many of these attempts at the same time, each as its own trajectory, without their states blurring together. Both are hard because the work is open-ended. A reproduction can produce useful code without supporting the paper’s central claim, support the claim but leave no reusable environment, or produce scores that look plausible until a later audit checks them. If these judgments live only in chat transcripts, the result is a collection of anecdotes. Swarm therefore turns each paper attempt into an auditable trajectory: the assigned agent, budget, workspace state, results, milestone, and next role are explicit at every step. Figure 20 shows the end-to-end path: a pool of paper workspaces, each driven through an ordered role workflow under a milestone gate, ending in an artifact that is either accepted or set aside.
blocks.zh: Swarm有两个工作。 第一种是每张纸:它推动一种复制,跨越许多代理商的转折和若干角色,使尝试保持连贯,如建设者交出、重试和审计彼此的工作。 第二个是横跨报纸的:它同时运行着许多这样的尝试,每一个作为自己的轨迹,而它们的状态不会一起模糊. 两者都很困难,因为工作是开放式的。 复制可以产生有用的代码,而不支持纸张的中央索赔,支持索赔,但不留下可重复使用的环境,或者产生看来可行的分数,直到以后的审计检查。 如果这些判决只存在于聊天记录中,结果就是收集了传闻. 因此,Swarmam将每一份文件的尝试变成可审计的轨迹:指定代理人、预算、工作空间状态、结果、里程碑和下一个角色在每一个步骤都明确。 图20显示端到端路径:一串纸质工作空间,每个工作空间通过里程碑门下有序的角色工作流程驱动,以接受或搁置的文物结尾.

blocks.en: Figure 20 : Swarm coordination overview. Swarm drives a pool of paper workspaces in parallel. Each paper moves through an ordered role workflow—reproduce, design, package, verify—whose transitions are driven by wake events: worker start, job submit, job update, validation failure, and role transition. Progress is graded against a milestone ladder, from none up to full reproduction, and the milestone gate decides whether a paper’s artifact is accepted.
blocks.zh: 图20:沼泽协调概览。 Swarm 驱动一组并行的纸张工作空间. 每个文件都通过一个命令性的角色工作流程——复制、设计、包装、核实——哪些转变是由醒悟事件驱动的:工人开始、工作提交、工作更新、验证失败和角色过渡。 进展是按一个里程碑式的阶梯,从无到完全复制,里程碑式的大门决定是否接受纸质的文物。

blocks.en: Swarm turns a paper into a finished environment. Its builders reproduce the paper’s main claim, design the reproduction into a usable task, organize its files, and verify the result. Swarm does not run this in one long session. A builder works in short turns, and ends each turn with an action, usually submitting a compute job or signaling that it is done. Swarm tracks that action and the paper’s state, and whenever something changes it wakes the builder with a prompt written for that exact situation: for example, when a compute job finishes, a prompt that carries the results and asks what to do next; when a build fails, a prompt with the build log and a request to fix it; when one stage is complete, a prompt that briefs the agent for the next. The agent is therefore only ever asked to decide the one thing that just came up. Swarm runs this loop over a pool of many workers, so it advances a large number of papers at the same time.
blocks.zh: 沼泽化纸为成品环境. 它的建筑商复制了纸张的主要主张,将复制设计成可使用的任务,整理档案,并核实结果。 沼泽不会在很长的一段时间里运行。 建设者以短转方式工作,每个回合以动作结束,通常提交计算工作或表示已完成. Swarm跟踪动作和纸的状态,当某事改变时,它会用一个写明的精确状态的即时提示来唤醒建筑者:例如,当一个计算工作完成时,一个随身携带结果并询问下一步要做什么的即时提示;当一个建筑失败时,一个用建构日志的即时提示和要求修复;当一个阶段完成时,一个为下一个阶段向代理提供简报的即时提示。 因此,特务只被要求决定 刚刚提出的一件事。 Swarm将这个环绕在众多工人的集合上,因此它同时推进了大量的论文.

blocks.en: Swarm answers the question that remains after a single agent turn ends: who should act next, and what do they inherit from the builder before them? Its unit of state is the paper, not the agent session: Swarm tracks where each paper sits in its workflow and the milestone it has reached, so a new builder resumes from the right point and can build on a partial result left by the previous one. This is what lets a single paper pass through several builders, even different models, and still read as one coherent attempt; without it, the final artifact would mix the paper’s difficulty with hidden differences in how the agent happened to be run.
blocks.zh: 斯瓦姆回答一个单一代理人转身结束后仍然存在的问题:下一步应该由谁行动,他们从他们之前的建造者那里继承了什么? 它的状态单位是文件,而不是代理会话: 每篇论文都坐落在其工作流程和所达到的里程碑上的Swarm轨迹,因此一个新的构建者从右侧点恢复,可以在前篇作品留下的部分结果的基础上继续发展. 这就是让一张纸通过几个造纸者,甚至是不同的模型,并且仍然读作一个连贯的尝试;没有它,最后的艺术品就会将纸的难度与代理商运行的隐性差异混为一谈。

blocks.en: Swarm wakes a builder only when new information changes what it should decide: a fresh paper or a new role to begin, a running job it may continue or cancel, a finished job, a failed build, an exhausted budget, a validation or milestone-gate failure, or a role transition. The agent returns a structured action, and Swarm records both the action and what prompted it. Table 5 summarizes what is shown.
blocks.zh: 只有当新的信息改变它应该作出的决定时,Swarm才会唤醒建设者:新纸或新角色开始,它可能继续或取消的运行中的工作,完成的工作,失败的建设,耗尽的预算,验证或里程碑门失败,或角色过渡. 特工返回一个有条理的动作,Swarm记录了动作及其动机. 表5汇总了所列内容。

blocks.en: Table 5 : Swarm wakes a builder only at decision-changing events. Rather than holding a session open for the whole reproduction, Swarm re-engages the builder only when new information changes what it should do next. Each row gives the triggering event, what the agent is shown, and the state Swarm writes into the paper’s trajectory.
blocks.zh: 表5:沼泽只在改变决定时才唤醒建筑商。 Swarm 与其举办一个面向整个复制的会话,不如只在新信息改变建设者下一步应做什么时,才重新与建设者接触. 每行都给出触发事件、代理人显示的内容,

blocks.en: When a builder declares a pass finished, Swarm separates local correctness from progress. The local check confirms the action is parseable and the milestone label is canonical, then runs the workspace validator, which verifies that the score files exist, the evaluator is separated from the method, and the workspace rebuilds from a clean clone (§ C.4 ). Failures become repair prompts, capped at three validation attempts. The progress check asks whether the claimed milestone clears the bar for the current stage; a run that falls short reverts to an earlier pass or stops (§ A.3.3 ).
blocks.zh: 当建设者宣布通行证完成后,Swarm会将本地的正确性与进度区分开来. 本地检查确认动作可解析,里程碑标签为cononical,然后运行工作空间验证器,验证分数文件存在,评估者与方法分离,工作空间从清洁克隆重建(§C.4). 故障成为修复提示,在三次验证尝试中封顶. 进度检查询问声称的里程碑是否为目前阶段清理了栏杆;短短的跑步恢复到较早的通过或停止(第A.3.3节)。

blocks.en: Swarm runs many paper workspaces through the same loop at once. It assigns idle Workers to saved workflow states, resumes the correct role after each turn, and sends experiment declarations to Nexus under that paper’s budget. The builder chooses the scientific next step; Swarm handles scheduling, accounting, and routing the returned evidence back to the right workspace.
blocks.zh: Swarm同时通过同样的循环运行许多纸工作空间. 它指派闲置的工人来保存工作流程状态,在每次转弯后恢复正确的角色,并在该文件的预算下向Nexus发送实验声明. 构建者选择科学的下一步;Swarm处理调度,会计,并将返回的证据返回到正确的工作空间.

blocks.en: A.3.1 Milestones
blocks.zh: A.3.1 里程碑

blocks.en: Swarm measures progress with a canonical milestone ladder, not with a binary success flag. The main target in the standard workflow is core_claim : a minimum experiment must run the paper’s method and support the central claim. method_runs records weaker progress when the method executes but the claim is not yet supported; core_claim_plus , secondary_claims , majority , near_complete , and full record broader coverage; and not_possible records a case that should not be converted into an environment. These labels let Swarm preserve partial progress without recording it as success. The canonical labels are listed in Table 6 . The agents self-report this.
blocks.zh: 沼泽用犬科里程碑梯级衡量进度,而不是用二进制成功旗. 标准工作流程的主要目标为核心(core_claim) :一个最低限度的实验必须运行纸张的方法并支持中央的主张. 方法_运行在方法执行时记录的进度较弱,但请求尚未得到支持; core_claim_plus, second_claims, 多数, 接近_完成, 以及完整记录的覆盖面较广;以及 无法记录一个不应该转换为环境的大小写。 这些标签使得Swarm保留了部分进展,而没有将其记录为成功. 犬科标签见表6。 特工自报此事.

blocks.en: Milestones also determine whether the workflow should continue. If a builder declares completion below core_claim , Swarm gives one or more turns asking for additional evidence. If a required pass still falls short, Swarm can stop the trajectory or revert to an earlier pass. This keeps failed attempts inspectable without letting weak evidence advance.
blocks.zh: 里程碑也决定了工作流程是否应该继续下去。 如果一个构建者宣布在核心_索赔下完成, Swarm会进行一个或多个回合, 请求提供额外证据 。 如果规定的通行证仍然不足,Swarm可以阻止轨迹或恢复到较早的通行证. 这使得失败的尝试可以检查,而不让薄弱的证据前进。

blocks.en: milestone not_possible none method_runs core_claim core_claim_plus secondary_claims majority near_complete full
blocks.zh: 图标不可_没有方法_运行 core_ claim 核心_ claim_ + 二级_ claims 多数接近_ 完整

blocks.en: Table 6 : Milestones make partial progress explicit. Swarm records one canonical label for each run.
blocks.zh: 表6:里程碑明确显示部分进展。 沼泽记录每跑一次的犬科标签.

blocks.en: A.3.2 Builder Roles
blocks.zh: A.3.2 建设者的作用

blocks.en: Swarm does not give every agent the same job. It separates reproduction, environment design, packaging, and verification so that later agents can inspect and improve the artifacts left by earlier agents; we refer to these roles collectively as builders , the agents that construct an environment from a paper. Reproducers build and test the paper method; design agents convert a successful reproduction into a scored environment; the packager makes the workspace reusable; and verifiers audit whether the final milestone is supported by evidence. This role split keeps the workflow from depending on a single long agent session while still preserving one shared workspace. Table 7 summarizes the role responsibilities and the gate to satisfy.
blocks.zh: 沼泽不会给每个探员一个工作 它将复制、环境设计、包装和核查区分开来,以便以后的代理人能够检查和改进早期代理人留下的文物;我们将这些作用统称为建造者,即建筑环境的代理人与纸张。 复制商建立并测试纸质方法;设计代理商将成功的复制转换成一个得分的环境;包装商使工作空间可以重复使用;以及验证商审核最终里程碑是否有证据支持. 这种角色的划分使得工作流程不依赖于单个长的代理会话,同时仍然保留一个共享的工作空间. 表7总结了作用责任和需要满足的大门。

blocks.en: Each builder also chooses the milestone that best describes the current workspace after it is done. The choice is a self-evaluation against the canonical ladder in Table 6 : the agent claims the milestone supported by runnable code, logs, scores, and notes, rather than simply reporting when the assigned role finishes. The label is a claim, not a verified fact, so it is never taken as final on its own: each later role and iteration inherits the same workspace and re-audits the previous agent’s claim, and the verifier lowers any milestone the workspace’s logs, scores, and code do not support. The bar for core_claim in particular is that the supporting run executes the paper’s own method on the paper’s task, possibly at reduced scale, and reproduces the direction of its central result, not merely that the code runs without error.
blocks.zh: 每个构建者还选择在完成后最能描述当前工作空间的里程碑. 选择是对照表6中的犬类阶梯进行自我评价:代理者声称里程碑由可运行代码,日志,分数,和注释支持,而不是简单地在指定角色完成时报告. 标签是权利要求,而不是一个经核实的事实,因此它从未被单独当作最终结果:每个后期角色和迭代继承相同的工作空间,并重新审计以前的代理人的权利要求,核查者降低工作空间的日志、分数和代码的任何里程碑。 特别是Core_Claim的栏目是,支持运行在纸张任务上执行纸本身的方法,可能缩小规模,并复制其中心结果的方向,而不仅仅是代码运行时没有错误。

blocks.en: Table 7 : Role separation keeps one workspace auditable across builder handoffs. The role split separates reproduction, environment design, packaging, and verification while keeping all roles on the same workspace and evidence trail.
blocks.zh: 表7: 角色分离使一个工作空间可以对建设者交割进行审计。 角色的分裂将复制,环境设计,包装和核查分开,同时将所有角色都保留在同一工作空间和证据线索上.

blocks.en: A.3.3 Workflow
blocks.zh: A.3.3 工作流量

blocks.en: The standard workflow is an ordered list of stage rows (Figure 21 ). Each row specifies the model profile, role, GPU-hour budget, milestone cap, minimum milestone, and optional revert target for that pass. When a pass finishes, Swarm compares the claimed milestone with the row’s minimum requirement. Meeting the gate advances to the next row; falling below it triggers the configured revert target, or otherwise stops the trajectory as unsuccessful. Because the budget is attached to the row, routine checks stay small, experiment-heavy rows receive more room, and every paper is judged under the same stage-level limits.
blocks.zh: 标准工作流程是订购的舞台行列表(图21). 每行指定模型配置,角色,GPU时预算,里程碑上限,最小里程碑,以及该通过可选的返回目标. 通行证完成后,Swarm将声称的里程碑与排队的最低要求进行比较。 迎合闸门推进到下一行;下降到下行触发所配置的返回目标,否则会停止轨迹以失败告终. 因为预算是附在排位上的,所以例行检查会保持小幅,实验重排会得到更多的空间,每张论文都会在相同的阶段级限制下判断.

blocks.en: Figure 21 : Swarm workflow stages. The standard workflow expands reproduction, design, packaging, and verification into repeated builder passes; each row carries the model profile, gate, GPU budget, and possible revert target.
blocks.zh: 图21:沼泽工作流程阶段。 标准工作流程将复制,设计,包装和验证扩展为重复的构建者通道;每行都携带模型配置,闸门,GPU预算,以及可能的还原目标.

blocks.en: A workflow can include repeated rows for the same role. This is deliberate: a single builder round may leave partial progress, fragile evidence, or an unresolved design choice that should be inspected before the workflow advances. Repeated rows let the next agent continue from the saved workspace, try a different strategy, or audit the previous claim without treating the role as complete.
blocks.zh: 一个工作流程可以包括同一角色的重复行. 这是有意的:单一的建设者回合可能会留下部分进展,脆弱的证据,或者在工作流程推进之前应当检查的未解决的设计选择. 重复行让下一个代理从保存的工作空间继续,尝试不同的策略,或者审核之前的主张而不将角色视为完整.

blocks.en: The handoff structure also makes the workflow a multi-agent process rather than a single long session. A later builder inherits the workspace, evidence, and gate left by the previous agent, so it can inspect earlier choices before extending them. This gives the system diversity in search strategy and reduces the chance that one mistaken assumption carries through the entire artifact. It also saves cost by placing lower-cost model profiles on routine continuation and reserving stronger profiles for difficult passes. Since the handoff includes the current milestone claim, each agent can revise the milestone selected by previous agents.
blocks.zh: 交接结构也使得工作流程成为多代理程序,而不是单个长会话. 后期建设者继承了前代代理留下的工作空间,证据和大门,因此可以在扩展之前检查早期的选择. 这使得系统在搜索策略上的多样性,并减少了一个错误的假设贯穿整个文物的机会. 它还通过将费用较低的模型简介用于例行延续和为困难通行证保留更强的简介来节省费用。 由于交接包括目前的里程碑索赔,每个代理人都可以修改以前代理人选定的里程碑.

blocks.en: A.4 Worker: Agent Interface
blocks.zh: A.4 工人:代理接口

blocks.en: We design Worker as one interface through which every agent scaffold CLI connects to the system. Scaffolds vary in how they are launched, resumed, and billed; Worker absorbs that variation so a model is judged on the research it produces, not on the scaffold that drives it. Figure 22 shows this path: heterogeneous scaffolds enter through one uniform turn interface, run inside a constrained container, and end each turn by writing an action.yaml that wakes the system for the next turn.
blocks.zh: 我们设计Worker作为一个接口,每个代理脚手架CLI通过它连接到系统. 脚手架的发射、恢复和计费方式各不相同; 工人吸收了这种变化,因此模型是根据它所产生的研究,而不是驱动它的脚手架来判断的。 图22显示了这一路径:各种脚手架通过一个统一的转向界面进入,在一个受限制的容器内运行,每个转向结束都写一个动作. 唤醒系统 下一转。

blocks.en: Figure 22 : Worker runtime overview. Different agent scaffolds connect through one uniform turn interface. Worker runs the agent under a container runtime with capped resources and a read-only validator, cycling through a turn loop of render prompt, agent acts, and submit jobs. Each turn ends by selecting the next action in action.yaml , which the system reads before waking the agent for the following turn.
blocks.zh: 图22:工人运行时间概览。 不同的代理脚手架通过一个统一的转向界面连接. 工人在容器运行时间下运行代理,充值资源和只读验证器,通过转圈循环,即时渲染、代理行为和提交工作。 每一回合最后选择下一个行动。 系统在唤醒代理后读到

blocks.en: A session is a sequence of turns. The first turn sets the agent up in its workspace; every later turn is short, sent only when something changes, such as a finished job or a failed build. The agent ends a turn by writing one file, action.yaml , that states its decision, shown in Figure 23 .
blocks.zh: 一个会话是转弯的顺序. 第一个回合将代理设置在其工作空间中;每个后来的回合都是短的,只有在某事发生变化时才发出,比如一个完成的工作或一个失败的构建. 代理结束一个回合 写一个文件,动作。 Yaml表示其决定,如图23所示。

blocks.en: Figure 23 : The action.yaml that ends a turn. The agent writes it to request the next job or to stop, and the system reads it after every turn.
blocks.zh: 图23:结束转弯的动作。 代理写作要求下一份工作或停止,系统每次转弯后都会阅读.

blocks.en: The agent makes its request in this fixed format. The system then processes it to decide the next step. action says whether to submit a job or declare the paper done; gpus and test set its size and route it to the full or the short test pool; milestone records the agent’s own assessment against the fixed milestone ladder. Because the agent never launches a job itself, the system can check every request, count it against the budget, and schedule it before it runs; a malformed one is handed back to rewrite, while the reasoning behind it survives in the turn record. The loop also removes any need to finish in a single session: the agent is re-engaged as jobs complete and builds fail, and progress accumulates between turns.
blocks.zh: 代理人以这种固定格式提出请求。 这个系统然后处理它来决定下一步。 动作表示是提交工作还是宣布文件已经完成; gpus 和 测试 设定其大小, 并引导它到达完整或短的测试池; 里程碑记录了代理商自己对固定里程碑阶梯的评估 。 因为代理商从不自己启动一个任务,系统可以检查每个请求,根据预算进行计数,在运行前安排;一个畸形的被递回重写,而其背后的推理则在转折记录中存活下来. 循环还取消了在单个会话中完成的任何需要:当任务完成并构建失败时,代理被重新参与,在转弯间进度累积.

blocks.en: We run the agent inside an Apptainer container ( Kurtzer et al., 2017 ) whose home is the paper workspace. It sees only a base image and that workspace: the container hides the cluster’s home and temporary directories and drops all administrator bind mounts, so the shared filesystems are out of reach. Inside, it edits code freely, and the GPU jobs it later submits reuse the same layout, so no host path is ever exposed. Three limits keep one agent from starving its neighbors: a memory cap to bound total RAM, a low scheduler priority to make co-located agents yield CPU, and thread caps on the numeric libraries.
blocks.zh: 我们在Apptainer容器(Kurtzer等人,2017年)内运行特工,其家是纸张工作空间。 它只看到一个基础图像和工作空间:容器隐藏集群的家和临时目录,并放下所有管理员绑定挂载,因此共享的文件系统无法到达. 内部,它可以自由编辑代码,而它后来提交的GPU工作会提出相同的再利用布局,因此没有主机路径被曝光. 三个限制使一个代理无法饿死它的邻居:一个内存封顶以绑定总RAM,一个低排程器优先度使同位代理生成CPU,以及数字库上的线程封顶.

blocks.en: Installing packages is separated from running jobs. The agent does not install during a job; it declares what it needs in two workspace files: environment/container.def for the base image and OS packages, and environment/setup.sh for Python packages. The system builds these once and keeps the result in a persistent overlay on top of the base image, so the packages are available to every later job without reinstalling or rebuilding the container. Editing either file triggers a rebuild before the next job runs.
blocks.zh: 安装软件包与运行中的工作分离 。 代理在工作期间不会安装;它会声明它所需要的两个工作空间文件:环境/容器. def用于基础图像和OS包,而Environment/setup.sh用于Python包. 系统一次构建这些,并将结果保留在底像上方的持久叠加,因此包可以提供给以后的每一个工作,而无需重置或重建容器. 编辑任一文件都会在下一个任务运行前触发重建 。

blocks.en: We place a few things outside the agent’s reach by construction: the bookkeeping files and the recorded trajectory are hidden, the validator is read-only, and git push is disabled so the system decides when work is published.
