Turns are stripped of credential patterns before they are written, since the per-paper repositories may be made public. And because a paper can span thousands of unattended turns, Worker recovers on its own: it retries transient errors such as rate limits, switches to another model profile on terminal ones such as an exhausted usage cap, and kills a stalled turn along with its whole process tree.
blocks.zh: 我们通过构建将一些东西置于代理商的范围之外:簿记文件和记录的轨迹是隐藏的,验证器是只读的,而git推力是被禁用的,所以系统决定工作何时出版。 转弯在写作前就被剥夺证书图案,因为纸质寄存器可能公开. 而由于一张纸可以跨越数千个无人看管的转弯,Worker自行恢复:它重复了诸如速率限制等瞬间错误,在终端上切换到另一个模型配置,比如一个耗尽的用量盖,并杀死了一个停滞的转弯,连同整个过程树.

blocks.en: A.5 How the Components Connect
blocks.zh: A.5 组件如何连接

blocks.en: The four components pass work to each other through recorded state, not inside one long agent session. Worker presents the paper and workspace to the agent and reads its action from action.yaml . Swarm owns the paper’s trajectory: it tracks the milestone, advances through the workflow of roles, prepares the workspace, and turns a submit action into a job request for Nexus. Nexus checks the project’s budget, its concurrency cap, and the requested resource pool, then forwards the job to Hive, which runs it.
blocks.zh: 四个组件通过记录状态互相传递工作,而不是在一个长的代理会话内. 工人向代理人介绍论文和工作空间,并宣读其行动。 雅姆尔。 Swarm拥有论文的轨迹:它跟踪里程碑,通过角色流程的进步,准备工作空间,并将提交动作变成Nexus的工作请求. Nexus检查项目的预算、其货币上限和要求的资源库,然后将工作转交给运行它的Hive。

blocks.en: Results travel back through the same components. Hive reports the job’s state, return code, and resource usage; Nexus matches the finished job to its run record, writes the logs and outputs into the workspace, releases the GPUs it was holding, and charges the run against the project’s budget. Swarm reads the event, updates the paper’s state, and wakes the Worker for the next turn. Because everything lands as files the agent can open, not as hidden service state, a later turn or a different model can look back at what each job did and how it ended.
blocks.zh: 结果经过同样的部分。 Nexus将完成的工作与其运行记录相匹配,将日志和输出写入工作空间,释放它持有的GPU,并将运行费用计入项目预算。 Swarm阅读事件, 更新报纸状态, 因为每样东西都作为文件登陆,代理可以打开,而不是作为隐藏的服务状态,一个后转或不同的模型可以回顾每个工作做了什么以及它是如何结束的.

blocks.en: The split gives each component a single, narrow responsibility, and that is what keeps the system auditable. Worker can think and edit but cannot give itself compute; Swarm can coordinate papers but does not run jobs; Nexus enforces resource limits without judging scientific progress; Hive runs jobs without knowing which claim they support. Because the boundaries between them are clean, the four parts are meant to work independently, and any one of them can be swapped for a different implementation, a new scaffold, scheduler, or compute backend, without touching the others. The final artifact is tied to both sides: the agent trajectory that produced it, and the run records that make that trajectory checkable.
blocks.zh: 拆分给予每个组成部分一个单一的,狭义的责任,这就是使系统可以审计的原因. 工人可以思考和编辑,但不能自己计算; Swarm可以协调文件,但不运行任务; Nexus 在不判断科学进展的情况下强制实施资源限制; Hive运行任务时不知道他们支持哪一个声称. 由于它们之间的界限是干净的,所以四个部分的本意是独立工作,其中任何一个部分都可以被换成不同的执行,一个新的脚手架,排程器,或者计算后端,而不碰其他部分. 最终的文物被捆绑在两侧:生产它的代理轨迹,以及使该轨迹可以检查的运行记录.

blocks.en: Appendix B Builder Design
blocks.zh: 附录B 构建器 设计

blocks.en: runs entirely on autonomous agents: every environment is produced by builders that reproduce a paper and shape the result into a task, with no human in the loop. This section describes how those builders work and the principles that decide whether the environment they leave behind is a good one. Figure 24 gives the overview: from a paper and an empty workspace, builders produce a reusable environment across problem definition, method reproduction, and evaluation.
blocks.zh: 运行完全依靠自主的代理:每个环境都由建筑者产生,他们复制纸张,将结果塑造成任务,循环中没有人类. 本节介绍这些建筑商的工作方式以及决定他们留下的环境是否良好的原则。 图24概述了:从纸张和空的工作空间来看,构建者在问题定义、方法复制和评价方面创造了可重复使用的环境。

blocks.en: Figure 24 : Builder overview. From a paper (in PDF and Markdown) and an empty starter workspace, builders build a reusable environment along three tracks: a problem definition that states the task and its constraints without leaking a solution, a reproduction of the paper’s method whose code and experiments recover the central claim, and an evaluation harness with visible and hidden slices that turns outputs into scores.
blocks.zh: 图24:构建者概览。 从一篇论文(在PDF和Markdown中)和一个空的启动工作空间,建设者沿着三个轨道构建了可重复使用的环境:一个问题定义,说明任务及其限制而不泄露一个解决方案,一个复制的论文方法,其代码和实验恢复了中心主张,以及一个带有可见和隐藏的切片的评价工具,将输出转化为分数.

blocks.en: B.1 What the Builders Do
blocks.zh: B.1 建设者做什么

blocks.en: § A described the system that runs the builders; this section is about the research task it is built for. Given a single published paper, the agents must reproduce the paper’s central result and leave behind a reusable environment, an executable setup in which a later scientist can attempt to improve on that result. This is the foundation everything else rests on, since an environment whose method was never really implemented would have nothing to measure. The rest of this subsection traces what the agents actually do, from the paper to the finished environment and how each turn is driven; the design choices behind that environment follow in § B.2 .
blocks.zh: § 翻译: 一个描述的是运行构建者运行的系统;这一节是关于它所建造的研究任务. 考虑到一份单一的出版论文,代理商必须复制论文的核心结果,并留下一个可重复使用的环境,一个可供后期科学家尝试改进这一结果的可执行设置。 这是其他一切的基础,因为一个从未真正实施过方法的环境将没有任何东西可以衡量。 本小节的其余部分跟踪了物剂的实际作用,从纸张到成品环境,以及每个转弯是如何驱动的;该环境背后的设计选择在§B.2中遵循.

blocks.en: A builder’s input is the paper itself, in both Markdown and PDF with its figures, together with a fresh, empty workspace. The reproducer starts from this and proceeds in order. It first reads the paper and writes a short briefing, separating the problem and the evaluation protocol from the paper’s method, and transcribes the paper’s reported numbers into a reference scoring file. It then prepares the environment: downloading the data and any model weights in advance, writing an evaluator that scores outputs without depending on the method, and checking that the scoring file is well formed. With that in place it implements the method and reproduces incrementally, submitting compute jobs to get one experiment that supports the core claim running before expanding to further settings, and recording its measured numbers alongside the paper’s. Reproduction usually spans several agents in turn: each later one inherits the saved workspace, audits what the previous agent built, and pushes it further.
blocks.zh: 建构者的投入是纸本身,在Markdown和PDF中都有其数字,还有新鲜的空工作空间. 复制者从这个开始,然后按顺序进行. 它首先阅读论文并撰写简短的情况介绍,将问题和评价协议与论文的方法区分开来,并将论文报告的数字转录为参考评分文件. 然后它准备环境:提前下载数据和任何模型加权,写一个评价者在不取决于方法的情况下对输出进行评分,以及检查评分文件是否形成良好. 因此,它采用这种方法并逐步复制,提交计算工作,以便先进行一项支持核心索赔的试验,然后再扩展到进一步设置,并同时记录其测量的数字。 复制通常会依次跨越几个代理:每个后人继承所保存的工作空间,审计之前的代理所构建的东西,并推进.

blocks.en: Table 8 : Each turn is prompted for its condition. The first turn is a full role briefing; later turns receive a short prompt for whatever event woke the builder, keeping it on task across a long unattended run.
blocks.zh: 表8:每次转弯都按其状况排列。 第一个转弯是全面的角色简报;后来转弯会得到一个短促的提示,不管任何事件唤醒了建设者,它都会在长期无人关注的情况下执行任务。

blocks.en: A working reproduction is not yet a usable environment. Once the method runs and supports the claim, a designer adds the visible and hidden evaluation slices and the scripts that produce their scores; a packager makes the workspace rebuild from a clean clone, with every dataset and model fetched by a self-contained download script; and a verifier audits the whole artifact before it is accepted. How these roles are sequenced, what budget each receives, and how progress is graded are handled by the system (§ A.3 ); what each role leaves in the workspace is detailed in § C .
blocks.zh: 工作复制还不是有用的环境。 一旦方法运行和支持索赔,一个设计师会添加可见和隐藏的评价片段以及产生其分数的脚本;一个包装器使工作空间从一个干净的克隆中重建,每个数据集和模型都由自成一体的下载脚本获取;以及一个验证器审核整个文物后才能被接受. 这些角色是怎样排序的,每个角色都得到什么预算,进展的等级如何由系统处理(§A.3);每个角色在工作空间留下的是什么,详见§C.

blocks.en: The builder works in turns, ending each by requesting a compute job or declaring the work done, and runs fully autonomously with no human in the loop (§ A.4 ). Because a paper can span thousands of unattended turns, it is not given one fixed instruction. Where § A.3 describes when an agent is woken and what state it is shown, here the point is what it is then asked to do: the first turn carries the full role briefing, and every later turn is a short prompt written for the condition that woke it. Table 8 lists the main conditions and the instruction each prompt carries.
blocks.zh: 建造者轮流工作,最后要求计算工作或申报已完成的工程,完全自主地运行,循环中无人(§A.4). 由于一张纸可以跨越数千个无人看管的转弯,因此它没有获得一个固定的指令. §A.3描述一个代理人何时被唤醒以及显示什么状态时,这里的要点是它接下来被要求做什么:第一个转弯带有完整的角色简报,每一个后转弯都是为唤醒它的条件写作的简短的提示. 表8列出了主要条件和每个提示符的指令。

blocks.en: B.2 Design Choices
blocks.zh: B.2 设计选择

blocks.en: A good environment does not come from reproducing a paper alone; it also has to be designed so that a later method can be tested fairly on it, all under a limited compute budget. We follow seven design choices toward this, each stated first and then explained.
blocks.zh: 一个良好的环境不单单来自纸张的复制;还必须设计这种环境,以便后一种方法能够在它上得到公平的测试,所有这一切都是在有限的计算预算下进行的。 我们遵循七个设计选择, 每一个都先说,然后解释。

blocks.en: Design choice 1. Reproduce the paper’s method and core claim, not its exact numbers. Scale down resources when needed, but preserve the experimental procedure and keep the task non-trivial.
blocks.zh: 设计选择 1. 重述文件的方法和核心索赔,而不是确切的数字。 必要时缩小资源规模,但保留实验程序,保持任务非三角性.

blocks.en: The goal is to make the paper’s method run, not to match a table entry. Exact-number reproduction rewards the wrong behavior: a builder could tune toward the published values, or copy them outright, without implementing the method. Instead, the environment should contain the paper’s actual computation and produce reasonable support for the claimed effect. A simple check is whether a reader of the code can recognize the algorithm from the paper.
blocks.zh: 目标是让报纸的方法运行,而不是与表格条目匹配. 准确的数字复制奖励了错误的行为:一个构建者可以调和已公布的值,或者直接复制,而不执行方法。 相反,环境应包含文件的实际计算,并对所声称的效果提供合理的支持。 一个简单的检查是,一个读取代码的读者是否能够从纸张中识别算法.

blocks.en: Most papers cannot be reproduced at full scale under a fixed budget. The builder may therefore reduce the model size, dataset size, or number of training steps, which also keeps reproductions friendlier to the broader community using the artifact. What it may not do is change the procedure. If the paper trains from scratch, the environment trains from scratch. If the paper uses a particular optimization setup, the environment keeps that setup. Resources can shrink; the experiment cannot become a different experiment.
blocks.zh: 大多数文件不能在固定预算下全面复制。 因此,建造者可能减少模型大小,数据集大小,或训练步骤的数目,这也使利用文物的复制更适合更广泛的社区. 它可能不会做的是改变程序。 如果纸质列车从零开始,环境列车从零开始. 如果纸张使用特定的优化设置,环境会保持这种设置. 资源可以收缩;实验不能变成不同的实验.

blocks.en: Scaling down also has a limit. A task made too small becomes trivial, and a trivial task cannot distinguish the paper’s method from a weak baseline. When a builder uses a smaller or synthetic dataset, it must check that a basic baseline does not already solve the problem. If the reproduced method is no better than random guessing, majority class, or another weak baseline within noise, the reproduction has failed. The environment needs a real gap so that future agents have something meaningful to improve.
blocks.zh: 缩小也有限度。 一项太小的任务变得微不足道,一项微不足道的任务不能将文件的方法与薄弱的基线区分开来。 当一个构建者使用一个较小或合成的数据集时,它必须检查一个基本基线是否已经解决问题. 如果复制的方法不比随机猜测,多数类,或者噪音内的另一个弱基线更好,复制失败了. 环境需要真正的差距,以便未来的行动者有有意义的改进。

blocks.en: Design choice 2. Keep the problem separate from the solution: the problem should be stateable without the paper’s method, and the evaluator and data should not depend on that method.
blocks.zh: 设计选择 2. 将问题与解决办法分开:没有纸张方法,问题就应该可以解决,评估者和数据不应依赖该方法。

blocks.en: This boundary keeps the problem definition independent of the solution that produced it. The problem, its data, and its evaluator can be stated and run without the paper’s method, so the environment poses the problem on its own terms rather than only as a continuation of one particular implementation; the file boundary is described in § C.2 . The separation also protects the score. If the evaluator secretly depended on the reproduced method, then changing the method might not change what is measured, and the environment would look functional while no longer testing the intended problem.
blocks.zh: 这个边界使问题定义独立于产生它的解决方案. 问题、其数据及其评估者可以不采用纸张方法来说明和运行,因此,环境以其本身的方式提出问题,而不是仅仅作为某一具体执行的继续;文件边界在§C.2中描述。 分离也保护了分数. 如果评价人员暗中依赖所复制的方法,那么改变方法可能不会改变所测量的内容,环境看起来会起作用,而不再测试预期的问题。

blocks.en: The separation must hold at runtime, not only in the file layout. The evaluator must read the outputs a method produced, never call the method’s code: if deleting method/ would change the evaluation scores, the boundary is broken. Likewise, the data loaders belong to the problem, not the solution, and must not import from method/ . The evaluate scripts must also discover methods dynamically, enumerating whatever methods exist on disk rather than hardcoding a name, so that the evaluator works for a future method without editing. How the environment is then presented to a future agent is a matter for evaluation (§ E.1 ).
blocks.zh: 分离必须在运行时保持,而不仅仅是在文件布局中. 评价者必须读取产出一种方法,绝不使用该方法的代码:如果删除方法/将改变评价分数,则边界被打破。 同样,数据加载器属于问题而非解决方案,不得从方法/ 导入. 评估脚本还必须动态地发现方法,列举磁盘上存在的任何方法,而不是硬编码一个名字,这样评估者就可以为未来的方法工作而不编辑. 然后如何向未来的代理人介绍环境是一个需要评估的问题(E.1节)。

blocks.en: Design choice 3. Provide a visible evaluation slice for development, and reserve a matched hidden slice for final evaluation to detect shortcuts and overfitting.
blocks.zh: 设计选择 3. 为开发提供一个可见的评价片段,并为最终评价保留一个匹配的隐藏片段,以检测捷径和过于吻合。

blocks.en: The finished environment includes an evaluation suite that a future scientist can see and optimize against. If that suite is only one metric on one dataset, the easiest path may be to game that number rather than improve the underlying idea. To reduce this risk, the designer builds two slices: a visible slice for development and a hidden slice that is run only after done. A large gap between the two suggests overfitting or shortcuts.
blocks.zh: 成品环境包括一个评估套件,未来科学家可以看到并优化对照. 如果该套套件在一个数据集上只有一个度量,那么最简单的路径可能是游戏这个数字,而不是改进基本的想法. 为了减少这种风险,设计师建造了两块:一个用于开发的可见切片和一个只完成后才运行的隐藏切片. 两者之间的巨大差距暗示了过度适应或快捷键.

blocks.en: The split can be drawn in different ways, depending on the paper: held-out samples, held-out subgroups, harder inputs, or several related metrics that measure the same claim from different angles. Using multiple metrics from different angles is stronger than a single held-out number, because a single metric can be gamed while triangulation from several directions catches shortcuts that any one metric would miss.
blocks.zh: 拆分可以不同的方式绘制,取决于纸张:搁置样品,搁置分组,更硬的投入,或从不同角度测量相同主张的几个相关衡量标准. 使用不同角度的多个度量衡比单一的悬停数更强,因为一个度量衡可以在从几个方向进行三角化时捕获任何一个度量衡都会错过的捷径.

blocks.en: The hidden slice must be calibrated against the visible one in difficulty: both should probe the method at roughly equal rigor, using matched data scales, evaluation protocols, and sample counts. An honest method should score similarly on both; if the hidden slice is simply harder, then every method will look worse there and the gap will be meaningless. The two slices should also be independent, so reading or importing the visible evaluator does not reveal the hidden one. And the test slice should be lightweight: it re-scores existing artifacts or slices them differently, rather than retraining or re-running expensive inference.
blocks.zh: 隐藏的切片必须对照困难的可见切片进行校准:两者应使用相匹配的数据尺度、评价协议和抽样计数,以大致相等的刚度探测方法。 一个诚实的方法应该同样地在两者上得分;如果隐藏的切片只是更难,那么,每一个方法在那里看起来都更糟糕,而差距将是毫无意义的. 这两个切片也应该是独立的,所以读取或导入可见的评价师不会揭示隐藏的. 而测试切片应该是轻量级的:它重新盘点现有的文物或者以不同的方式切片,而不是再培训或者重做昂贵的推断.

blocks.en: Design choice 4. Score future methods on the quantity the paper cares about, not on how closely they match the paper. Fix the constraints needed to make gains meaningful.
blocks.zh: 设计选择 4. 今后根据文件所关心的数量确定计分方法,而不是根据它们是否与文件相匹配。 解决取得有意义的成果所需的制约因素。

blocks.en: An environment should allow future methods to improve on the paper. For that reason, the score must not measure distance from the paper’s published number. Such a metric would make the paper’s own method the target and turn the environment into a reproduction-fidelity test. The paper’s reported numbers should be recorded as context, but future methods should be scored on the underlying quantity: accuracy, loss, robustness, sample efficiency, parameter count, or whatever the claim is actually about.
blocks.zh: 环境应允许今后在文件中改进方法。 因此,得分不得衡量与报纸公布的号码的距离。 这种衡量标准将使该报自己的方法成为目标,并将环境变成一种复制可靠性测试。 所报数字应作为上下文记录,但未来方法应在所涉数量上打分:准确性、损失、稳健性、抽样效率、参数计数或索赔实际涉及的方面。

blocks.en: This principle is enforced in the scoring schema: metric names that encode closeness to the paper, such as deviation , vs_paper , or agreement_with , are blocked by the validator, so the score must name the underlying scientific quantity.
blocks.zh: 这一原则在评分方案中得到执行: 编码到纸张接近度的度量名称, 如偏差 , vs_paper, 或 和 的协议_ , 被验证器阻断, 因此分数必须指定基础科学数量 。

blocks.en: The environment must also define what stays fixed. A future scientist should not win by using more compute, a larger model, more data, or a different training paradigm unless that is the allowed direction of improvement. For papers that claim a benefit without a cost, the evaluator should measure both sides: the benefit that should improve and the constraint that should not break. The scoring contract expresses this through metric coefficients: a positive coefficient marks a benefit to maximize, a negative one marks a constraint that must not degrade, and the experiment weights reflect how central each result is to the paper’s claim.
blocks.zh: 环境也必须界定哪些因素保持不变。 未来的科学家不应该通过使用更多的计算,更大的模型,更多的数据或者不同的训练范式来获胜,除非这是允许的改进方向. 对于主张无成本好处的论文,评价者应衡量双方:应改善的好处和不应打破的限制。 评分合同通过衡量系数来表达这一点:正系数表示实现最大化的好处,负系数表示不得降解的限制,实验权重反映每种结果对报章索赔有多重要。

blocks.en: Design choice 5. Score on quantities that do not depend on the machine. Replace hardware-sensitive measures such as latency or wall-clock time with stable proxies.
blocks.zh: 设计选择 5. 按不依赖机器的数量计分。 以稳定的代位取代对硬件敏感的措施,如耐久或壁点时间.

blocks.en: Hardware varies from run to run, so a latency or wall-clock measurement can swing severalfold with no change to the method, and an environment that scored it would reward landing on a faster GPU rather than finding a better idea. Scores therefore use quantities that are stable across machines: parameter count, FLOPs, training steps, examples processed, or final task performance. When the paper’s own claim is about speed or efficiency, the environment keeps the claim but measures it through a machine-independent proxy rather than the clock.
blocks.zh: 硬件在运行时各有不同,因此耐久或壁钟的测量可以在没有改变方法的情况下翻几番,一个打分的环境会奖励降落在更快的GPU上而不是找到更好的想法. 因此分数使用在机器上稳定的数量:参数计数,FLOP,训练步骤,处理的例子,或最终任务性能. 当纸张本身的主张涉及速度或效率时,环境会保留主张,而是通过机器独立的代理而不是时钟来测量.

blocks.en: Design choice 6. Reproduce enough of the paper to give future scientists a real surface to improve, preferably a small matrix over the paper’s own axes rather than one isolated number.
blocks.zh: 设计选择 6. 重写足够多的论文,让未来的科学家有一个真正的表面来改进,最好是在论文本身轴上有一个小的矩阵,而不是一个孤立的数字。

blocks.en: A one-number reproduction is too thin a target. A future scientist may match it and still have little room to learn from or improve. Once the core claim runs, the environment should expand along the axes the paper itself studies: datasets, input difficulty, model scale, ablations, data regimes, or other relevant settings. A small matrix over two meaningful axes is usually more useful than repeated runs of the same setting.
blocks.zh: 单数复制太薄的目标. 未来的科学家可能与之相匹配,但仍然几乎没有学习或改进的余地. 一旦核心索赔开始运行,环境应沿着文件本身的研究轴线扩展:数据集、输入困难、模型尺度、缩放、数据制度或其他有关设置。 两个有意义的轴上的小矩阵通常比同一设置的重复运行更有用.

blocks.en: This matrix does not need to be large. It needs to expose the structure of the claim. Combined with the non-triviality check above, it turns the environment from a single point estimate into one with headroom: weak baselines leave a gap, the reproduced method occupies a recognizable starting point, and future methods have several genuine ways to improve.
blocks.zh: 这个矩阵不需要很大. 它需要揭示索赔的结构。 加上上面的非三角性检查,它把环境从一个单一点的估计数变为一个有头室的估计数:薄弱的基线留下了空白,复制的方法占据了可识别的起点,未来的方法有几种真正的改进方法.

blocks.en: Design choice 7. The environment must rebuild and rerun from a fresh clone, with every external resource fetched by a self-contained script and every dependency declared.
blocks.zh: 设计选择 7. 环境必须从一个新的克隆体中重建和重新运行,每个外部资源都由自成一体的脚本获取,并宣布每个依赖。

blocks.en: An environment that only works on the machine that built it is not reusable. The download script must fetch every dataset, model weight, and external resource from a public source using executable commands, not comments or placeholder URLs. It must be idempotent and must not reference local shared paths that exist only on the original cluster. The container definition and setup script must declare every system and Python dependency so that the software rebuilds without manual intervention. And every local import in the evaluation, method, and baseline code must resolve to a file tracked by git, so that a fresh clone contains everything the experiments need to run.
blocks.zh: 一种只在制造它的机器上工作的环境是不能重复使用的. 下载脚本必须使用可执行命令从公共来源获取每个数据集,模型重量和外部资源,而不是注释或占位符 URL. 它必须具有独断专行性,不得提及仅存在于原始集群的本地共享路径。 容器定义和设置脚本必须宣布每个系统和Python依赖性,这样软件就可以在没有人工干预的情况下重建. 而评估、方法和基线代码中的每一个本地导入都必须解决到git跟踪到的文件,这样新的克隆就包含实验需要运行的一切。

blocks.en: The validator enforces this: it scans committed code for references to machine-local shared directories and checks that every import target is a tracked file. Together with the reproducible-execution scripts (§ C.3 ), this makes the environment a portable artifact rather than a snapshot of one session’s state.
blocks.zh: 校验器执行此功能:它扫描已承诺的代码,以查找机器本地共享目录的引用,并检查每个导入目标是否是一个跟踪文件. 这与可复制的执行脚本(§C.3)一起,使得环境成为可移植的文物,而不是一个会话状态的快照.

blocks.en: Appendix C Agent Workspace
blocks.zh: 附录C 代理工作空间

blocks.en: The workspace is the single directory the builders work in and the artifact they leave behind. Its layout is what makes the result a reusable environment rather than the residue of one run. We describe its structure (§ C.1 ), its problem statement and scoring (§ C.2 ), its execution (§ C.3 ), and its records and checks (§ C.4 ).
blocks.zh: 工作空间是建筑者所工作的单一目录和留下的文物. 它的布局使得结果成为一个可重复使用的环境,而不是一个运行的残留物. 我们描述其结构(第C.1节)、问题陈述和评分(第C.2节)、执行(第C.3节)、记录和检查(第C.4节)。

blocks.en: C.1 Structure
blocks.zh: C.1 结构

blocks.en: Each paper is reproduced inside a single working directory, and that directory is also the artifact the builders leave behind. During the run it holds the code, data, experiments, and notes; once the run ends, it is designed to stand on its own, so that another party can clone it, rebuild the environment, rerun the method, and obtain the same scores without access to the original session. This is what distinguishes a reusable research environment from the residue of a single successful run, in which the method is entangled with the evaluator, the data exists only in a local cache, and the scores carry no well-defined meaning. The layout shown in Figure 25 is designed to prevent these failures.
blocks.zh: 每份文件都在一个工作目录内复制,该目录也是建筑商留下的文物。 在运行期间它持有代码,数据,实验,以及笔记;一旦运行结束,它就被设计成自己站立,这样另一方就可以克隆它,重建环境,重新运行方法,并在没有访问原始会话的情况下获得相同的分数. 这就是可重复使用的研究环境与一次成功运行的残留区别的所在,其中方法与评价者纠缠在一起,数据只存在于本地缓存中,分数没有明确的含义. 图25所示布局旨在防止这些故障.

blocks.en: Figure 25 : The agent workspace. A single directory holds the paper and briefing, the reproduced method and baselines, the data and evaluator, the scoring contract, the run scripts and environment, and the root-level record and validation files. Each directory has a single responsibility, which keeps the problem separated from the solution, lets the workspace rebuild and rerun from a fresh clone, and preserves a record of how the reproduction was produced.
blocks.zh: 图25:代理工作空间。 单一目录保存着论文和简报、复制的方法和基线、数据和评价员、评分合同、运行的脚本和环境以及根级记录和验证文件。 每个目录都有一个单一的责任,它把问题与解决方案分开,让工作空间从一个新鲜的克隆中重建和重新运行,并保存了复制是如何产生的记录.

blocks.en: The layout is a deliberate design choice rather than a storage convention: each directory has a single responsibility. The briefing defines what a future scientist may know; method/ and baseline/ hold what the reproducer built; data/ and eval/ define the problem interface that any method must satisfy; scoring/ defines how a method is judged; and scripts/ and environment/ determine whether the workspace runs outside the original session. Table 9 summarizes the groups.
blocks.zh: 排版是有意的设计选择,而不是存储惯例:每个目录都有单一的责任. 简报界定了未来的科学家可能知道的内容;方法/和基线/持有复制人所构建的内容;数据/和eval/定义任何方法必须满足的问题界面;评分/定义方法如何判断;脚本/和环境/确定工作空间是否运行在原会话之外. 表9汇总了各组情况。

blocks.en: Table 9 : Each directory has one responsibility. The workspace keeps task context, method code, evaluation, scoring, execution, and record state apart, so a later scientist can reuse it without the original conversation.
blocks.zh: 表9:每个目录都有一个责任。 工作空间保持任务上下文,方法代码,评价,评分,执行,以及记录状态分开,因此后期科学家可以在没有原对话的情况下重新使用.

blocks.en: C.2 Problem and Scoring
blocks.zh: C.2 问题和评分

blocks.en: The workspace deliberately separates the problem from the solution so that the problem is method-agnostic: it states what must be achieved and how it is measured, without revealing the paper’s approach. This is what allows the workspace to serve as a fair task for any future method rather than a recreation of one particular solution. The boundary appears in two places. In the briefing, problem.md gives the research question and success criteria and evaluation.md the metrics and protocol, neither naming the method; only method.md describes the paper’s approach, and overview.md summarizes the finished workspace. In the code, method/ contains the reproduced algorithm, while eval/ and data/ are written to work for any method, so a score never depends on the specific implementation. Because the problem stands on its own, an innovate scientist can attempt it from the briefing and evaluator alone, whereas an improve scientist additionally receives method/ as a starting point (§ E ).
blocks.zh: 工作空间有意将问题与解决方案区分开来,使问题具有方法不可知性:它说明必须实现什么和如何衡量,而不透露论文的方法. 这使得工作空间能够成为任何未来方法的公平任务,而不是一种特定解决办法的娱乐。 边界在两个地方出现。 在简报中,问题.md给出了研究问题和成功标准与评价. md 度量衡和协议,既不命名方法;只命名方法. Md描述了论文的方法和概述。 md总结了已完成的工作空间. 在代码中,方法/包含复制的算法,而eval/和data/则被写成适用于任何方法,因此一个分数从不取决于具体执行. 由于问题本身就存在,创新科学家只能从情况介绍和评价人员中尝试,而改进科学家则另外接受方法/作为起点(E节)。

blocks.en: Scoring is held in two files. scoring/reference.json records the paper’s reported numbers for each baseline and proposed method, along with the scoring rules: a weight per experiment, set by the agents to reflect how central that result is to the paper’s core claim (weights sum to one), the direction of each metric, and a label marking each method as a baseline or a proposed method. scoring/scores.json holds the numbers the reproduction actually produced. A later method is scored by its improvement over those reproduced numbers, in each metric’s direction and combined by the weights, so the score measures progress over the reproduction rather than closeness to the paper. Figure 26 shows the two files side by side.
blocks.zh: 斯科林被保存在两个文件中. 评分/参考.json记录了每份基准和拟议方法的报数,以及评分规则:每个试验的权重,由代理人设定,以反映该结果对论文的核心索赔(权重对1),每一公尺的方向,以及标记每种方法作为基准或拟议方法的标签。 得分/分数. json持有实际产生的复制数量. 后一种方法的得分是,它比那些复制的数字,在每一公尺的方向上,加上权重,因此得分衡量的是复制进度,而不是接近纸张。 图26同时显示两个文件.

blocks.en: Figure 26 : The scoring contract, held in two files. scoring/reference.json fixes the weights, metric directions, coefficients, and the paper’s reported numbers; scoring/scores.json holds the numbers the reproduction actually produced, under the same keys.
blocks.zh: 图26:分数合同,分为两个档案。 评分/参考.json 确定加权数,计量方向,系数,以及报数;评分/分数. json持有复制实际产生的数字,在同一键下.

blocks.en:
The JSON files fix the numbers, but a scientist also requires the intent behind them. Four short markdown files provide it: TARGETS.md states what to optimize, CONSTRAINTS.md states what must remain fixed, DIRECTION.md states which kinds of change are permitted, and EXPERIMENTS.md describes each scored experiment without disclosing the method. Together they exclude trivial gains, such as substituting a larger model, adding unrelated data, or altering the problem itself, while preserving room for a genuine methodological improvement. For example, an agent may improve performance on a Mamba architecture optimization problem by replacing the architecture with a Transformer. While this could yield better results, such a change provides no scientific value, as it sidesteps the original problem rather than advancing our understanding of how to improve Mamba models themselves.
When a paper makes a trade-off claim, both sides must be scored: the benefit and the constraint it must not violate. Otherwise the easiest route to a high score is to break the very condition the paper was designed to satisfy.
blocks.zh:
JSON文件修复了数字,但科学家也需要其背后的意图. 4个简短的标记文件提供了它:TARGETS.md说明什么是优化,CONTRAINTS.md说明什么是必须保持固定的,DIRECTION.md说明什么是允许改变的,EX 警告S.md在不披露方法的情况下描述每一个得分的实验. 它们共同排除了微不足道的收益,例如替代一个更大的模型,增加不相关的数据,或改变问题本身,同时保留真正改进方法的余地。 例如,一个代理可能通过用变形器取代架构来改进在曼巴架构优化问题上的性能. 虽然这可以产生更好的结果,但这种改变没有科学价值,因为它回避了最初的问题,而不是促进我们了解如何改进曼巴模型本身。
当一份文件提出权衡要求时,双方都必须得分:利益和限制不得违反。 否则,最容易达到高分的路线就是打破纸所要达到的条件。

blocks.en: C.3 Execution
blocks.zh: C.3 执行

blocks.en: The workspace must be able to rebuild from source, not only on the machine where it was created. scripts/download.sh fetches external data, weights, and other public resources; it must be idempotent and must not reference local shared paths. environment/container.def captures the system dependencies and environment/setup.sh the packages. scripts/method.sh then runs the reproduced method, scripts/baseline.sh runs the comparisons, scripts/evaluate.sh scores the outputs through eval/ , and scripts/reproduce.sh runs the full pipeline end to end. The workspace is therefore an executable artifact rather than a static record of results: a fresh clone rebuilds the environment, reruns the method, and regenerates the score files.
blocks.zh: 工作空间必须能够从源头重建,而不只是在创建它的机器上重建. 脚本/下载.sh获取外部数据、权重和其他公共资源;它必须是一元化的,不得引用本地共享路径。 environment/container.def 捕获系统依赖性和环境/设置.sh 软件包。 脚本/方法.sh然后运行复制的方法,脚本/基线.sh运行比较,脚本/评价.sh通过eval/,以及脚本/再制作对输出进行评分. SH运行整个输油管端到结束。 因此,工作空间是可执行的文物,而不是成果的静态记录:新鲜的克隆重建环境,重新运行方法,重新生成分数文件.

blocks.en: A finished workspace also includes a train/test split for the scientist who reuses it. The visible slice, eval/train/ , is what a future agent develops against; the held-out slice, eval/test/ , lives in the environment’s pristine source copy and is materialized into a run only for the final score, so it is never present in the agent’s working tree during development. The paired scripts/evaluate_train.sh and scripts/evaluate_test.sh write scores_train.json and scores_test.json . The purpose of the split is not to make the paper harder to reproduce but to detect a future agent that has overfit the visible evaluator.
blocks.zh: 成品工作空间还包括供重新使用该空间的科学家使用的列车/测试拆分. 可见的切片, eval/train/, 是未来代理商的开发对象; 被搁置的切片, eval/test/, 生活在环境的原始原始源拷贝中, 配对脚本/评价_train.sh和脚本/评价_test.sh写分数_train.json和分数_test.json. 拆分的目的不是使纸张更难复制,而是检测出一个未来使可见评价者超合的剂.

blocks.en: C.4 Records and Validation
blocks.zh: C.4 记录和验证

blocks.en: Each choice in the workspace exists to rule out a specific way it could fail to transfer to a new scientist. Figure 27 collects them: the design decision, the failure it prevents, and where it lives.
blocks.zh: 工作空间中的每一种选择都存在,排除了它可能无法转移给新科学家的特定方式. 图27收集了它们:设计决定,它防止的故障,以及它居住的地方.

blocks.en: Figure 27 : Each design choice targets a concrete failure mode. The workspace is structured to avoid solution leakage, method-coupled scoring, unrebuildable dependencies, evaluator overfitting, and unsupported claims.
blocks.zh: 图27:每个设计选择都针对一个混凝土故障模式. 工作空间的结构是为了避免溶液渗漏、方法相连接的评分、无法重建的依赖性、评价者过于匹配和无根据的索赔。

blocks.en: When a run ends, the system writes a manifest.json into the workspace and compiles a README.md containing a per-iteration reproduction log, alongside the git history that checkpoints every turn. Together these tie the result to recorded state rather than to the conversation, allowing a later agent or reviewer to trace how it was reached. Table 10 groups the fields the manifest records.
blocks.zh: 当运行结束时,系统会写一个清单. json 进入工作空间并编译一个 README。 md 包含一个每进一次的复制记录 以及每个转弯都检查的原始历史 两者共同将结果与录音状态而不是对话联系起来,使后来的代理人或审查者能够追踪如何达成结果。 表10将表单记录的字段分组。

blocks.en: Table 10 : The finished workspace records how it was produced. manifest.json ties each accepted artifact to the builders, compute, and components behind it, so it stays auditable after the session ends.
blocks.zh: 表10:完成的工作空间记录生产情况。 明确.json将每个接受的文物与建造者联系起来,计算,以及背后的组件,所以在会话结束后仍然可以审计.

blocks.en: A workspace is checked before it is accepted. validate.py runs automatically and enforces the scoring schema, blocks the obvious paper-agreement metric names, and checks the structural rules that keep the workspace independent of its own method and rebuildable from a fresh clone; Table 11 lists the checks in full. The markdown audit files then cover what code cannot decide: MILESTONES.md states the claimed milestone, PROGRESS.md and VERIFICATION.md record why it is justified and what was changed from the paper, and CHECKLIST.md confirms that the workspace is ready for both improve and innovate mode reuse. A workspace is accepted only when the automatic checks pass and the audit files are complete.
blocks.zh: 工作空间在被接受之前会被检查 。 验证。 py自动运行并执行评分计划,屏蔽明显的纸质协议度量衡名称,并检查结构规则,使工作空间独立于自己的方法,可以从新的克隆中重建; 表11列出全部的检查. 减记审计文件涵盖代码无法决定的: MILESTONES.md称,所称的里程碑、PROGRESS.md和VERIST.md记录了为什么它有正当理由,以及从报纸中更改了什么,以及CHECKLIST。 md确认工作空间已准备好改进和创新模式再利用。 只有在自动检查和审计文件完成后,才接受工作空间。

blocks.en: Table 11 : What validate.py checks before a workspace is accepted. The validator enforces the scoring schema, blocks scores that measure agreement with the paper, and verifies that the workspace is independent of its own method, rebuildable from a fresh clone, and free of train/test shortcuts.
blocks.zh: 表11:接受工作空间前的验证.py检查。 校验器执行评分计划,块计分器测量与纸张的协议,并验证工作空间独立于自己的方法,可以从新鲜的克隆中重建,没有火车/测试快捷键.

blocks.en: Every workspace is a git repository, and the system commits to it continuously, so the full trajectory can be replayed from the repository alone, without the session that produced it. Each agent edit is committed as it is made, and each job submission is committed together with the exact code it ran, so the state behind any result is pinned to a specific revision. When a job finishes, its logs are written back into the workspace and committed as tracked files, so what ran and what it produced live in the same history as the code. The builder cannot publish: git push is disabled, and the system decides when it is released (§ A.4 ).
blocks.zh: 每个工作空间都是git寄存器,系统不断承诺执行,因此完整的轨迹可以单独从寄存器中重播,而不需要产生它的会话. 每个代理编辑都按其制作方式进行承诺,每一份工作报告都与它所操作的确切代码一起进行,因此任何结果背后的状态都取决于具体的修改. 当一个工作完成后,它的日志会被写回工作空间,并作为跟踪文件来承诺,所以它运行和生成的东西和代码在同一个历史中进行直播. 构建者不能发布:git push被禁用,系统决定何时发布(§A.4).

blocks.en: Evaluation reuses the same git-backed design with one branch per attempt. Each time a model is run on an environment, that attempt is isolated on its own branch, so attempts never interfere, and each one can be inspected, rescored, or rerun on its own from the committed state it started from.
blocks.zh: 评价重复使用同样的基特支撑设计,每次尝试一个分支. 每当一个模型运行在一个环境上,这个尝试就被隔离在自己的分支上,所以尝试从不干预,每个模式都可以被检查,重新计分,或者从它从承诺的状态开始独立运行.

blocks.en: Appendix D Selecting Papers
blocks.zh: 附录D 选择 论文

blocks.en: Not every paper can or should become a suitable environment. A useful task has to be both worth reproducing and feasible for an autonomous builder to attempt under a bounded budget. Before any reproduction begins, we therefore narrow a large pool of recent papers down to a smaller, category-balanced set through a staged pipeline: cheap model screens drop low-quality and off-type papers, a deeper analysis scores each remaining paper for quality and reproduction difficulty, and a final ranking and balancing step chooses the papers we attempt. The rest of this section walks through that pipeline and reports how many papers survive each stage.
blocks.zh: 并不是每份报纸都能或应该成为一个合适的环境。 一项有益的任务必须是值得复制的,也是可行的,以便一个自主的建筑商在限定的预算范围内尝试。 因此,在开始复制之前,我们把一大批最近的文件缩小到一个较小的、分类平衡的、通过一个分阶段的管道设置的:廉价的模型屏幕将低质量和非类型的文件降下,对每份剩余文件进行更深入的分析,以确定质量和复制难度,最后的排名和平衡步骤选择我们尝试的论文。 本节其余部分走过管道,报告每个阶段还有多少文件。

blocks.en: We assemble the candidate pool before any builder is launched. Our selection snapshot is exported from a global arXiv index of 124,816 unique papers. The index is built from daily category listings between January 1, 2025 and March 1, 2026, and exported on March 28, 2026. We restrict the source categories to cs.CL, cs.CV, cs.AI, and cs.LG (Figure 29 ), then deduplicate by arXiv ID because the same paper can appear under more than one category. We also drop papers whose primary category is statistics (the stat.* group), which are dominated by theoretical work that offers little to execute or reproduce. This gives the candidate pool a temporal and topical boundary before any model is asked to judge feasibility. Figure 28 reports how many papers survive each screening stage from this pool onward.
blocks.zh: 我们在任何建造者启动前 组装候选游泳池 我们的选取快照是从124 816份独特论文的全球arXiv索引导出。 该指数从2025年1月1日至2026年3月1日的日类上市中构建,2026年3月28日出口. 我们限制源类别为cs.CL,cs.CV,cs.AI,和cs.LG(图29),然后用arXiv ID去除,因为同一纸可以出现在多个类别下. 我们还放弃主要类别为统计的论文(统计*组),这些论文以理论工作为主,几乎没有可供执行或复制。 这使候选人在要求任何模型判断可行性之前都有一个时间和专题界限。 图28报告,从这支队伍起,每个筛选阶段都有多少论文。

blocks.en: Figure 28 : Screening preserves nearly all unique papers before deeper analysis. Counts are computed from the selection snapshot used by the export. Shares after the unique-index row use 124,816 as the denominator.
blocks.zh: 图28:筛选在深入分析之前保存了几乎所有独特的论文。 从导出所用的选择快照中计算出数 。 唯一索引行后的共享使用124,816作为分母.

blocks.en: Figure 29 : The source pool is largest in cs.AI and cs.LG before deduplication. These are category-listing records before ID-level deduplication; a single paper can contribute to multiple rows.
blocks.zh: 图29:来源池在cs中最大. 分解前的AI和cs.LG. 这些是ID级解码前的分类列表记录;单纸可以促进多行.

blocks.en: Before any model reads a paper, we convert its PDF into Markdown with MinerU ( Wang et al., 2024 ) , which extracts the text, tables, and figures into a clean form that the screening and analysis models can read directly. The first two passes over this text are cheap, high-recall screens rather than final selection rules. Each pass sees only the opening 15,000 characters of the converted paper, which typically span the abstract and introduction, so that screening cost stays low across the full index. The first pass returns a quality score: MiniMax M2.7 ( MiniMax, 2026 ) reads the excerpt and emits a short justification together with an integer rating from 0 to 100. A second pass assigns each paper one of five types: metric-method, benchmark/dataset, analysis/findings, theoretical, or survey/position. The quality screen is broad: 94.3% of scored papers are at least 50, 40.5% are at least 70, and only 12.0% reach 80 or higher. The type screen is more selective in the direction needs: 94,161 papers, or 75.9%, are labeled metric-method. Figure 30 reports the full quality-score and paper-type distributions. The quality screen is the gate into deep analysis: structured analysis runs only within the top quality band, papers scoring 75 or higher (33,393 papers, the top 26.9%), and 21,354 of them complete the analysis under the analysis budget. The fast type label guides this stage but does not filter it; the decisive type filter uses the structured analysis’s own classification and appears as the first drops in Figure 32 .
blocks.zh: 在任何模型阅读论文之前,我们将它的PDF与MinerU(Wang等人,2024年)一起转换成Markdown,它将文本,表格和数字提取成一个清晰的形式,筛选和分析模型可以直接读取. 前两段通过此文本是便宜的,高调的屏幕,而不是最终的选择规则. 每张通行证只看到被转换的纸张的15,000个字符的开口,这些字通常跨越抽象和引入,这样整个索引的筛选成本就保持低水平. 第一次通过返回一个质量分数:MiniMax M2.7(MiniMax,2026年)读取节录,并发出一个简短的理由,加上整数分数从0到100. 第二次通行证将每份文件分为五个类型之一:计量方法、基准/数据集、分析/调查、理论或调查/位置。 质量屏幕宽度:94.3%的得分论文至少50张,40.5%至少70张,只有12.0%达到或超过80张. 类型屏幕在方向需求上更具选择性:94,161份论文,即75.9%,是标注的度量法. 图30报告了全部质量分数和纸张类型的分布。 质量屏幕是深入分析的大门:结构化分析只在最高质量波段内运行,论文评分为75分或以上(33,393份论文,前26.9%),其中21,354份在分析预算下完成分析. 快速类型标签指导这个阶段,但不过滤;决定性类型过滤器使用结构化分析本身的分类,并作为图32中的第一滴出现.

blocks.en: Figure 30 : Fast screens keep broad coverage while identifying metric-method papers as the dominant type. The left side summarizes 123,980 fast quality scores; the right side summarizes 124,018 fast paper-type labels.
blocks.zh: 图30:快屏幕保持广泛的覆盖,同时将衡量方法文件确定为主导类型。 左侧总结了123,980个快速质量分数;右侧总结了124,018个快速纸型标签.

blocks.en: Papers carried forward from the fast screens go through a deeper analysis with MiniMax M2.7 ( MiniMax, 2026 ) , which classifies each paper and records a reproduction-oriented catalog entry. The first and most decisive field is the paper type. We keep only method papers, whose contribution is a method or technique evaluated with measurable results, and set aside the other four types: benchmark or dataset papers, where the contribution is the evaluation rather than a method; analysis or findings papers, which report observations rather than improvements; theoretical papers, whose contribution is a formal result; and survey or position papers, which carry no original experiments. Only method papers fit a reproduce-then-improve task, where an agent has to implement a method and then improve on a measured number.
blocks.zh: 从快速屏幕上结转的论文通过MiniMax M2.7(MiniMax,2026)更深入的分析,其中对每篇论文进行分类,并记录一个面向复制的目录条目. 第一个也是最具决定性的领域是纸张类型. 我们只保留方法文件,其贡献是用可衡量的结果加以评价的方法或技术,并搁置其他四种类型:基准或数据集文件,其中贡献是评价而不是方法;分析或结论文件,其中报告观察而不是改进;理论文件,其贡献是正式结果;调查或立场文件,其中没有原始实验。 只有方法文件才适合复制时改进的任务,即代理人必须执行一种方法,然后改进一个计量的数字。

blocks.en: The remaining fields describe each surviving paper in more detail: contribution novelty, taxonomy, compute and paid-resource requirements, benchmarks, datasets, baselines, concrete dependencies on other papers, code availability, reproduction difficulty, research quality, and problem novelty, with every scalar judgment given as an integer score from 0 to 10. Reproduction difficulty is split into coding, compute, time to run, and data or model difficulty, plus an overall score, because a paper should not be chosen on scientific appeal alone; a useful task also has to be feasible for an autonomous agent under a bounded budget. Figure 31 shows how these scores are distributed across the analyzed papers.
blocks.zh: 其余的字段更详细地描述了每篇幸存的论文:贡献新奇,分类学,计算和付费资源要求,基准,数据集,基线,其他论文的具体依赖性,代码可用性,复制难度,研究质量,以及问题新奇,每个分级判断给出的整数分数从0到10. 复制难度分为编码,计算,运行时间,数据或模型难度,加上总体分数,因为论文不应该单靠科学吸引力来选择;一个有用的任务也必须在一定的预算范围内对一个自主的代理人可行. 图31显示这些分数如何在分析论文中分布。

blocks.en: Figure 31 : Structured-analysis score distributions across the 21,354 analyzed papers. Each panel gives the share of papers at each integer score from 0 to 10: the five reproduction-difficulty sub-scores (coding, compute, time to run, data or model, and overall), and the paper-level quality and problem-novelty scores. Dashed lines mark the means. Difficulty scores concentrate in the low-to-middle range, while quality and problem novelty center higher.
blocks.zh: 图31:21 354份分析论文的结构分析分数分布。 每个面板给出每整数分数0至10的论文份额:5个复制难度分数(编码,计算,运行时间,数据或模型,以及总体),以及纸张质量和问题创新分数. 折叠线标记手段。 难度分数集中在中低级范围,而质量和问题新颖性中心则更高.

blocks.en: The final selection balances importance against feasibility. Let q q be the 0-10 paper quality score, and let r r be the aggregate reproduction difficulty. When all four reproduction subscores are present, we compute r = 5 ​ r overall + 1.25 ​ ( r code + r compute + r speed + r data ) 10 . r=\frac{5r_{\mathrm{overall}}+1.25(r_{\mathrm{code}}+r_{\mathrm{compute}}+r_{\mathrm{speed}}+r_{\mathrm{data}})}{10}. It then ranks eligible papers by u = ( q / 10 ) ​ ( 1 − r / 10 ) u=\sqrt{(q/10)(1-r/10)} , so a paper must be both scientifically strong and reasonably reproducible to rank highly. Code availability is recorded but is not a hard requirement, which allows to include papers where agents must reconstruct missing pieces. The filtering counts in Figure 32 are sequential counts from the exported snapshot, each paper attributed to its first rejecting rule.
blocks.zh: 最后的选择兼顾了重要性和可行性。 让 q q 成为 0-10 纸质分数, 让 r 成为 总体 复制 难度 。 当所有四个复制子分数都出现时,我们计算 r = 5 r 整体 + 1.25 (r 代码 + r 计算 + r 速度 + r 数据 ) 10. r ffrac{ 5r_{\ mathrm{ overall}}+1.25(r_{\ mathrm{ code}}+r_{\ mathrm{ compute}}+r_{\ mathrm{ speed}}+r_{\ mat mathrm{ data}} }}10}). 然后由u=(q / 10) (1 – r / 10) u=\sqrt{(q / 10) (1-r/10)}对符合条件的论文进行排名,因此论文必须既科学强健,又可以合理复制,才能排高. 守则的可用性被记录下来,但并不是一项硬性要求,它允许包括特工必须重建缺失碎片的文件。 图32中的过滤计数是从导出快照中依次计数,每张纸都归于其第一个拒绝规则.

blocks.en: Figure 32 : Feasibility filters reduce 21,354 analyzed papers to 8,987 candidates. The feasible candidates are ranked by quality-feasibility utility before the final category-balanced selection.
blocks.zh: 图32:可行性过滤器将21 354份经分析的论文减少到8 987名候选人。 在最后的类别均衡甄选之前,按质量可行性的效用对可行候选人进行排名。

blocks.en: Figure 33 : Temperature-balanced sampling keeps large areas prominent while preserving smaller categories. The final 1,000-paper selection is sampled from 8,987 feasible candidates across 18 canonical categories.
blocks.zh: 图33:温度平衡取样保持大面积突出,同时保留较小的类别。 最终的1 000份纸质选择从18个犬类的8 987名可行候选人中抽取。

blocks.en: The feasible pool is still highly uneven across topics, so we do not simply take the top 1,000 utility scores. We first map fine-grained taxonomy labels into 18 canonical categories, then allocate final slots using temperature-smoothed category shares with temperature 1.2 1.2 . The largest categories remain large, but smaller categories are not squeezed out entirely. Figure 33 shows the candidate pool and selected count for each canonical category. Figure 34 reads the resulting environments in their own words: what each asks to make better, and the work delivering it requires.
blocks.zh: 各种议题之间的可行集合仍然高度不平衡,因此,我们不只拿最高的1 000个公用事业分数。 我们首先将细纹分类标签映射到18个犬类,然后使用温度分泌的1.2 1.2 的温度分泌类别份额分配最后的槽。 最大的类别仍然很大,但较小的类别并不完全挤出。 图33显示每个犬类的候选人才库和选定数目。 图34用自己的话来解读由此产生的环境:每个环境都要求更好,交付工作也需要更好。

blocks.en: Figure 34 : What environments ask, and the work it takes. Each environment states what should get better and what work that takes; phrases are grouped into families that emerge from data; ribbon mass is the share of environments.
blocks.zh: 图34:环境要求什么,需要什么工作。 每种环境都说明应该改进哪些工作以及需要哪些工作;短语被组合成来自数据的家庭;丝带质量是环境的份额。

blocks.en: Appendix E Evaluation Protocol
blocks.zh: 附录E 评价议定书

blocks.en: Evaluation is the scoring harness that turns the reproduced environments into comparable scores across models. Where Swarm is built for open-ended builder coordination, Evaluation is deliberately flatter: it runs one controlled trial for each combination of paper, model, and mode. Each trial starts from a fresh workspace, receives a bounded compute budget through Nexus, drives one agent session through reason-run-feedback turns, and records the resulting train and held-out test scores. The harness splits this into auditable stages, from scaffolding through normalization (Table 12 ). The unit of comparison is therefore explicit: a model is judged by what its agent can build under the same problem statement, workspace boundary, scoring contract, and compute budget. We call this evaluated agent the scientist agent , to distinguish it from the builders that construct an environment (§ A.3.2 ).
blocks.zh: 评价是将所复制的环境转化为各种模型的可比分数的评分办法。 在Swarm为开放式建设者协调而建造的地方,评价被刻意奉承:它为纸、模型和模式的每一种组合进行一个控制的试验。 每一次试验从一个新的工作空间开始,通过Nexus获得一个定界计算预算,通过理性运行-反馈转弯驱动一个代理会话,并记录由此产生的列车和搁置测试分数. 管制将它分为可审计阶段,从脚手架到正常化(表12)。 因此,比较的单位是明确的:一个模型是根据其代理人在同样的问题说明、工作空间界限、评分合同和计算预算下可以构建的。 我们称这个评估过的代理人为科学家代理人,以区别于构建环境的建筑者(第A.3.2节)。

blocks.en: E.1 Evaluation Modes
blocks.zh: E.1 评价模式

blocks.en: Each environment can be run in two modes that ask different questions of a model. In improve mode, the scientist is given the reproduced method and the train-phase scores it already achieves, and must push those numbers higher without changing the evaluation protocol; the question is whether the model can advance an existing result. In innovate mode, the agent is given only the problem statement, the constraints and targets, the visible evaluator, and the data interface, with an empty method directory, and must build a method from first principles; the question is whether the model can solve the problem on its own.
blocks.zh: 每个环境都可以用两种模式运行,对一个模型提出不同的问题. 在改进模式中,给予科学家复制的方法和它已经实现的列车阶段分数,必须在不改变评价协议的情况下将这些数字推高;问题在于模型能否推进现有结果. 在创新模式中,代理只得到问题说明,限制和目标,可见的评价师,以及数据接口,并带有空的方法目录,必须从第一原理构建一个方法;问题在于模型是否能够自行解决问题.

blocks.en: The two modes are the problem-and-solution separation of § B.2 made operational: the same environment, presented once with the reproduced method and once without it. This separation is built into the workspace layout, not just the prompt. The reproduced method lives in its own method/ directory, while the problem statement, scoring targets, visible evaluator, and data interface sit outside it, and the evaluator and data never import from method/ (§ C ). Because the rest of the environment does not depend on the method, a single change switches modes: method/ is handed over intact for improve mode and emptied for innovate mode. They are kept separate in both the run matrix and the normalization, because a score earned by inventing a method from scratch is not the same experimental object as one earned by improving an existing method.
blocks.zh: 两种模式是第B.2节的解问题分离:同样的环境,一次用复制的方法呈现,一次没有它。 这种分离被构建到工作空间布局中,而不仅仅是即时. 所复制的方法存在于自己的方法/目录中,而问题说明、评分目标、可见评价员和数据接口则位于其之外,评价员和数据从未从方法/(§C)中导入。 由于环境的其余部分并不依赖于方法,所以一个单一的改变开关模式:方法/被完整地移交用于改进模式,而空用于创新模式. 它们在运行矩阵和正常化中都是分开的,因为从头发明一种方法所得的分数与改进现有方法所得的实验对象不同。

blocks.en: E.2 Running a Trial
blocks.zh: E.2 进行审判

blocks.en: Evaluation controls what the scientist can see and modify. The problem briefing, data, baseline artifacts, and visible training evaluator are read-only. The method directory, run scripts, scratch directory, and scoring directory are writable. Held-out test files, test scripts, reference scores, and the paper text are not present during the main phase. This boundary prevents agents from tuning against the hidden test split while still giving them enough information to conduct real research: they can read the task, implement a method, run the visible evaluator, inspect failures, and iterate. In improve mode, the starting method’s train score is copied into the briefing as a target to beat, but it is not used as an oracle during scoring.
blocks.zh: 评估控制着科学家能够看到和修改的东西. 问题简报、数据、基线文物和可见的培训评估员只读。 方法目录,运行脚本,抓取目录,评分目录都是可书写的. Hold-out测试文件,测试脚本,参考分数,纸质文本在主阶段不出现. 这个边界防止了代理对隐藏的测试分裂进行调试,同时仍然给他们足够的信息进行真正的研究:他们可以读取任务,执行一种方法,运行可见的评价员,检查故障,以及脚踏实地. 在改进模式中,起始法的列车得分被复制到简报中作为击败的目标,但在打分时它不被用作神谕.

blocks.en: Table 12 : Evaluation separates iteration, validation, hidden testing, and normalization into auditable stages. The staged harness keeps scientist behavior inspectable and comparable.
blocks.zh: 表12:评价将迭代、验证、隐藏测试和正常化分为可审计阶段。 台式机能使科学家的行为可以检查和比较。

blocks.en: At the end of each turn, the scientist declares whether it wants to submit a compute job or finish. A submitted job runs the workspace’s compute entrypoint through Nexus, using the requested CPU or GPU resources and optionally the short test capacity for smoke tests. Evaluation does not implement its own execution loop; it consumes the job results that Nexus exposes and resumes the same agent session with them. Current runs use a 200-turn ceiling, and a trial that fails for a transient reason before producing any score file is retried up to three times. Once scoring files exist, the workspace is kept for review rather than overwritten.
blocks.zh: 在每一回合结束时,科学家宣布是提交计算工作还是完成。 提交的任务通过 Nexus 运行工作空间的计算切入点, 使用请求的 CPU 或 GPU 资源, 并选择抽烟测试的短测试能力 。 评价不执行自己的执行循环;它消耗了Nexus暴露的工作结果,并与他们恢复同一个代理会话. 目前运行使用200转的天花板,在产生任何分数文件之前由于瞬间原因失败的试验最多重复三次. 一旦评分文件存在,工作空间就被保留审查,而不是覆盖.

blocks.en:
The main phase produces scores_train.json using the visible evaluator. A host-side validator then checks the output against the source scoring shape: for every required proposed method, every numeric metric present in the reference reproduction must also be present in the agent’s score file.
Metrics marked as baselines are ignored because they are not the scientist’s responsibility.
blocks.zh:
主阶段使用可见评价器产生分数_train.json. 一个主机侧校验器然后对照源评分形状检查输出:对于每一个所需的拟议方法,参考复制中存在的每个数字度量标准也必须出现在代理记分文件中.
标为基线的计量因不是科学家的责任而被忽视。

blocks.en:
After train validation passes, the method the scientist built is frozen: its directory is mounted read-only before the held-out evaluator runs, so the test score reflects exactly the method that produced the train score and cannot be tuned against the hidden split. Evaluation then materializes the held-out evaluator from a pristine clone, so the scientist cannot influence what the test runs, and executes
against the frozen method.
blocks.zh:
列车验证通过后,科学家构建的方法被冻结:其目录在被搁置评估员运行前仅挂载读取,因此测试分数准确地反映了产生列车分数的方法,不能与隐藏分数相对调. 因此科学家不能影响测试结果 执行测试
与冻结方法相对应。

blocks.en: If the test job fails, the default recovery path keeps the method and the hidden evaluator read-only for five repair turns, so the scientist can repair missing packages or regenerate artifacts without modifying the frozen method or peeking at held-out data. If those turns do not succeed, a final three-turn path makes method/ writable again under a stricter honesty prompt, so a genuine interface mismatch can be repaired; even then the held-out evaluator and test data stay read-only and re-materialized from the pristine clone, so the method can be fixed but the hidden split still cannot be read nor the scorer altered, and these unlock turns are flagged in the trace. A run is complete only when both train and test score files validate.
blocks.zh: 如果测试工作失败,默认的回收路径保留了方法,隐藏的评价师只读五个修复转折,因此科学家可以修复缺失的包或再生文物而不修改冻结方法或偷看被搁置的数据. 如果这些转弯不成功,最后的三转路径在更严格的诚实提示下使方法/写法再次可以使用,所以真正的接口不匹配是可以修复的;即使这样,被搁置的评审员和测试数据仍然只能从原始克隆中读取并重新物质化,因此这种方法可以固定,但隐藏的拆分仍然无法读取,也无法更改计分器,这些解锁转弯在跟踪中被标记. 只有当列车和测试分数文件验证时,运行才完成.

blocks.en: E.3 Scoring
blocks.zh: E.3 计分

blocks.en: Evaluation reduces each model to one comparable number per paper, its FNI, then averages over the ten into a leaderboard. The raw measurements are heterogeneous at three levels. Within a paper, the result is split across experiments and their metrics, which sit on different scales, so one in the hundreds must not swamp one in hundredths, and carry different importance, so a metric central to the claim should count more than an incidental one. Across papers, the natural improvement ranges from a fraction of a percent to tens of points, yet every paper should contribute equal magnitude rather than let large-swing papers dominate. Across models, the comparison must stay fixed: a later model is scored against numbers frozen at publication rather than re-baselined, with the sign preserved and no value clamped. The scoring function below reconciles these levels, one cell at a time.
blocks.zh: 评价将每个模型减少到每张纸一个可比数字,即其FNI,然后平均在10个以上进入领导板。 原始测量在三个层面是不同的。 在一篇论文中,结果被分成各种实验及其衡量标准,它们坐落在不同的尺度上,因此,百分之一的实验及其衡量标准绝不能淹没一百分之一,具有不同的重要性,因此,对索赔要求来说,一个衡量中心应该算得过一个偶然的标准。 在报纸上,自然改善的幅度从1%到数十点不等,然而,每份报纸应该贡献同等的份量,而不是让大片的报纸占据主导地位。 在各种模型中,比较必须保持不变:后一种模型是对照出版时被冻结的数字而不是重新定下基准,并保留标志,不扣值。 下面的积分函数调和这些关卡,一次一个单元格.

blocks.en: The scoring is built on the following objects, all fixed before any model is scored. • Reference cohort ℳ = { m 1 , … , m K } \mathcal{M}=\{m_{1},\dots,m_{K}\} : a fixed set of K K models, chosen once and frozen at publication. Each m k m_{k} is one model, and every model in ℳ \mathcal{M} is run on every paper. • Cell c c : one metric of one method in one experiment. A single paper has many cells, spread across its experiments and the several metrics each one reports; baseline methods are excluded, leaving only the proposed methods. • Source value s c s_{c} : the value the paper’s own method reaches on cell c c once reproduced; it is the reference every model is measured against. • Model value x m , c x_{m,c} : the value reached on cell c c by the method that model m m builds. • Direction d c ∈ { + 1 , − 1 } d_{c}\in\{+1,-1\} : + 1 +1 when a higher value is better, − 1 -1 when lower is better. • Prior weight p c = w e ⁡ ( c ) ​ | κ c | p_{c}=w_{e(c)}\,\lvert\kappa_{c}\rvert : how central the cell is to the paper’s claim, set by the builder when it writes the reference scoring file, not inferred from any model’s results. The agent records two numbers there: a weight w e w_{e} for each experiment, normalized to sum to one across the paper, and a coefficient κ c \kappa_{c} for each metric that sets the metrics within an experiment against one another. The prior weight is their product, taking the coefficient’s magnitude so that a metric’s direction (already captured by d c d_{c} ) does not affect its weight. The cohort is fixed because it calibrates every paper: adding a model to it would move every paper’s scale and baseline and invalidate all stored coefficients, so a later model is scored against the cohort, never added to it.

blocks.en: For a cell the cohort does not tie on, the normalizer from the previous paragraph is simply the cohort spread, n c = σ c n_{c}=\sigma_{c} . Dividing by this spread, rather than by the source value, is what places metrics of different scales on a common footing. The more obvious choice would divide each improvement by its source value, δ m , c / | s c | \delta_{m,c}/|s_{c}| ; but σ c \sigma_{c} is computed from those same improvements, so dividing them by | s c | |s_{c}| scales the cell and its spread alike, and the source value cancels: δ m , c / | s c | sd m ⁡ ( δ m , c / | s c | ) = δ m , c / | s c | σ c / | s c | = δ m , c σ c , s c ≠ 0 . \frac{\delta_{m,c}/|s_{c}|}{\operatorname{sd}_{m}(\delta_{m,c}/|s_{c}|)}=\frac{\delta_{m,c}/|s_{c}|}{\sigma_{c}/|s_{c}|}=\frac{\delta_{m,c}}{\sigma_{c}},\qquad s_{c}\neq 0. The cohort spread, not the source value, carries the scale. Writing the standardized cell score with the general normalizer, z m , c = δ m , c n c , z_{m,c}=\frac{\delta_{m,c}}{n_{c}}, and s c s_{c} sets only the zero point of the improvement, not its scale. The score also stays well defined when s c s_{c} is zero or near zero (for example, when a metric counts the number of bugs in a code snippet), where dividing by the source value would be undefined or blow a tiny gap into an enormous ratio.

The prior weight p c p_{c} records how important a metric is to the paper, but not how much it tells one model apart from another. A cell on which the whole cohort lands at nearly the same value carries little signal about which model is better, while a cell on which the cohort spreads out widely both separates models and is statistically reliable. We therefore scale each prior by the cell’s spread σ c \sigma_{c} relative to the paper’s typical spread τ \tau , and renormalize so the weights sum to one: w ~ c = p c ​ ( β + σ c σ c + τ ) , w c = w ~ c ∑ j w ~ j . \tilde{w}_{c}=p_{c}\left(\beta+\frac{\sigma_{c}}{\sigma_{c}+\tau}\right),\qquad w_{c}=\frac{\tilde{w}_{c}}{\sum_{j}\tilde{w}_{j}}. Here β \beta is a floor we set to 0.5 0.5 . The weight w c w_{c} this produces is each cell’s share of the paper score, so scaling it by the cell’s spread makes the score lean on the cells that actually separate models and discount those that do not. When the cohort ties on a cell ( σ c = 0 \sigma_{c}=0 ), every model scores it the same, so the cell cannot tell a better model from a worse one; counting it at full weight would only dilute the score with a cell that carries no signal, so the factor drops to its floor β = 0.5 \beta=0.5 , halving its influence without dropping it. When a cell spreads the cohort by the paper’s typical amount ( σ c = τ \sigma_{c}=\tau ), it carries a representative amount of signal and the factor stays at 1.0 1.0 , leaving its prior unchanged. When the cohort disagrees on a cell far more than usual ( σ c ≫ τ \sigma_{c}\gg\tau ), the cell sharply separates models and is the most informative, so the factor rises toward 1.5 1.5 and the cell counts for up to half again its prior. The factor saturates smoothly toward β + 1 \beta+1 rather than being clipped at a hard cap.

blocks.en: This does a different job from the normalizer: n c n_{c} puts every cell on a common scale, while w c w_{c} sets how much each cell then counts. Together they keep any single cell, an extreme-scale metric or a tied, uninformative one, from deciding a paper’s score by itself. As a final backstop against a near-tied cell whose tiny spread inflates its coefficient, any cell whose contribution both outweighs all of a paper’s other cells combined and exceeds one full paper score in magnitude is pruned, uniformly for every model, so no saturated metric can swing a paper’s score on its own.
